Oblina infiltrates the human race in a human suit. When the suit malfunctions, and she thinks she's human, Ickis and Krumm have to rescue her. While above the ground, a puppy saves Ickis from being run over.

When a human designer realeases a new fragrance, the monsters discover it works as a toxic gas against them. Oblina's not superstitious, but when she steps on a slug her luck changes.

Daggett is mistaken for the long-extinct Horned Beaver by two bumbling scientists. Their zeal to protect such a rare animal quickly becomes dangerous for everyone around Daggett.
The forest is invaded by the beavers mortal enemies: lumberjacks. These guys just don't cut down trees -- they sing, as well!
While on their way to a sports coliseum, Daggett annoys the bus driver who accidentally drives the bus through a hole in the fabric of space and time. The boys end up at the real Roman Coliseum!

Daggett and Norbert vie for their baby sister's affection when the two girls are left in their care for the weekend. While self-proclaimed child care guru Dag maps out an itinerary of Fun things to do, Norb allows them to do what they want.

Clarissa Makes A Cake: Clarissa pitches in to help celebrate her parents' anniversary.
Parents Who Say No: In an effort to break free from the shackles of kiddie jobs like babysitting, Clarissa asks for permission to apply for a job at the Baxter Beach Carnival.
Angelica tries to help Chuckie become more popular as a school project, but it backfires when he takes her advice, and he becomes more popular than her.
On a trip to a mountain resort, Tommy develops his first crush on a girl named Olivia.

When Susie gets a gig singing at Slosh Mountain, the world's coolest water park, she gives free tickets to all the Rats. The kids are thrilled, not so much about the show, but about getting the chance to go on the mother of all rides, Whiplash Gorge.

The whole school has caught Yu-Gotta-Go fever... except Chuckie. When he finally starts playing, it becomes an obsession. He becomes one of the school's best players, but in the heat of the game, he almost loses a precious gift.
After Stu sells an invention, he tells the kids that he's splurging on a built-in swimming pool. While digging up the yard, the construction crew unearths the Rats' old mechanical Reptar toy.
The Rats learn about Karma from Dil. Angelica signs up for a talent show but doesn't tell Susie. The other kids pull a prank and reap their just reward for it.

It's soccer season and Phil is soccer-crazy. Lil joins the team and becomes an instant success. So much that Phil starts to resent her. Lil must choose between walking away from a passion and respecting her only brother's feelings.
Tommy and the gang decide to put together a boxcar to compete in the upcoming derby. Can they make it to the finals, or will Angelica spoil their plans by entering her own car in the race?
Chuckie is dreading Christmas so to liven things up, he steals a tree. Meanwhile, Kira and Kimi are stuck at the airport, and Tommy and Dil try to write a Chanukah song.
It's been three months since the boys of Big Time Rush moved to Hollywood to record their demos. Now it's up to Griffin to decide the future of the band.
After learning that Gustavo is hosting a party at the studio that the boys are not invited to, they guys decide to host their own party at the Palm Woods.
The guys are continuing to live their Hollywood dream, however James, Logan And Carlos begin showing odd behavior.
The guys have been having a little too much fun living in Hollywood and after getting charged again for breaking stuff at the Palm Woods and Gustavo has had enough and makes them get jobs!

It is revealed to George and Katherine why Travis, Webster's late father, chose George to be Webster's godparents and legal guardians if something happened to them.

An unmitigated and sexy conman targets his next mark, the widowed Monique, for his latest swindle. But his routine scam hits a snag when suspicion mounts and his scheme quickly escalate into desperation, betrayal, and murder.
When a homeless ex-stock broker rescues a famous model from a robbery attempt, she takes him home as an act of gratitude.

After a night of cuddling together, Terri is ready to claim Brandon as her man. Unfortunately, Brandon isn't ready to commit and a crushed Terri is unsure of how to handle his change of heart.
House rules, a cold shower, and yelling escalate into an all-out-brawl that leads to someone being booted from the house.
Two wrongs, no rights! The cast has a hard time shaking off their disagreements over which cast member should've been booted from the house.
It's voting fever and the cast is deep into it, especially when Flo Rida agrees to support their efforts.
Malik continues his downward sprial of behavior, culminating in a drunken rage and assault against a police officer. He is arrested.

Uh oh! More trouble in paradise for Derwin and Melanie. Derwin, trying to avoid conflict with Melanie, keeps his reconciliation with Janay a secret, only to have it backfire when he sends Janay mixed signals about their relationship.

Malik, frustrated with rehab and convinced that he has no problems or addictions, leaves to attend a Sabers' party only to run into Jason and Derwin, who confront him about his reckless behavior and send him back to rehab to face his problems head-on.

When Kelly learns that her role on the reality show is in jeopardy, she goes to extreme measures to stay relevant, which ultimately backfires with daughter Brittany and forces Kelley to re-evaluate her future in San Diego.
When Malik turns down the advances of the wife of the Sabers' owner, she becomes upset and returns with a vengeance, unwilling to take no for an answer.

After a long dating dry spell, Phyllis reveals that she has a new man, Earl, who seems almost too perfect, but when Dee Dee discovers that Earl is married, Phyllis confesses that she already knew and must decide whether to do the right thing or her thing.
Mark avoids P.J.'s phone calls and learns, too late, that she had good news. Geneva plays a trick on Vanessa to teach Nicole a lesson.

Mark teaches Tyler how to be a tough guy so that he can protect Nicole against a bully at school. When Tyler's approach doesn't work, Geneva goes up to the school and makes a big scene, scaring the bully away. Vanessa takes care of her boss' prized orchid

Tensions rise, as Zac and Fatima deal with trust issues; Zac must ward off an insistent Deja.

Mr. Drysdale panics when Mrs. Drysdale comes back from Boston early because she'll meet the Clampetts.

Granny competes against Mrs. Drysdale as artists and tells Jed about her uncle, the barn painter. Jed and Jethro go to an upscale gallery to buy a painting, but are mistaken for gardeners. Bessie the chimp dabbles with a paintbrush.
Jethro decides he wants to go a courtin', so after Jed gives him a little education he finds a woman, who happens to be a stripper
Grannie and Cousin Pearl are at each other's throats over who's going to take care of the cooking and the house, so Jed has to find ways to keep them apart.
Drysdale hires Jed to be a banker when he needs a crack shot to help beat a rival banker in a skeet shooting competition, but his partner needs to be an employee.
The hillbilly women, assured of their equal rights, return to the Clampett mansion.
A father and daughter from back home come to Beverly Hills to meet Jed.
Mrs. Drysdale recommends Elly for a high-brow finishing school in hopes that humiliating her will drive the Clampetts away
After the Clampetts return from London, Granny gets a letter from Hooterville asking her to help with Betty Jo Elliot's baby.

When Granny hears the Drysdales are at a horse show, she declares she wants good trotter so she can ride it to the market. When Mr. Drysdale buys a racer along with a buggy, Granny decides she wants to be the driver at the track.
Jethro thinks the Drysdale's young attractive maid is interested in him. He commences to courting her but she is actually interested in watching the football game on the Clampett's color TV.
Jed, Ellie May, Jethro, and Granny take their first plane flight back home for Christmas to visit cousin Pearl, who is busy cooking up a feast to win Mr. Brewster's unwilling heart.

Granny's soap making sends noxious smoke into the air, which gets the attention of smog commissioner Tinsley. He shuts down the operation, and Jed decides to run against him when he misunderstands Mr. Drysdale's advice.

Granny remains eager to get Elly to the altar and decides Professor Biddle, Miss Jane's friend, will do. Mr. Drysdale blackmails Dash into asking the Clampett lass for a date. The meek birdwatcher and the handsome actor are soon at odds.
Jed Clampett has inherited a castle in the English countryside. Jethro insists that everyone, except Granny, wear the royal raiment's of Elizabeth (the First, of course).
(S01E003) Brenda shops with Kelly and Tiffany and wishes she had their kind of money.

(S01E006) An unreasonable teacher makes Brandon's life miserable by giving him no grade higher than a C.

(S01E017) Brenda's had it with home life and West Beverly and decides to leave both for the real world.

16 complete strangers will live in total confinement, cut off from the outside world. All summer long, they will compete for safety and power. Each week they will vote to evict one of their own until only one house guest remains to claim the grand prize.
Tonight the game is officially underway! Alliances will form, have-nots will be chosen, and Daniel will nominate two houseguests for eviction.
Linda copes with her son after her divorce is finalized while Sam has a problem with Danny's mother visiting too often.
Hattie uses love as a tactic to have Linda defend herself. Meanwhile, Linda asks to stay at Floyd's apartment after Hattie kicks her out.
At the diner, the health inspector comes in for an unannounced visit and Linda starts her first day working. Floyd and Linda frantically work to bring the diner up to code.
When a fire at Vivian's diner is deemed arson, everyone points their fingers at Hattie as the culprit. Later, a fire marshal comes into the diner to reveal the cause.
Hattie ponders the idea of creating a strategic business deal with Vivian after sales are slow at the diner. Meanwhile Sam, Drew And Danny argue over who will receive a promotion at work.
Danny has reached a limit with Sam's overbearing party habit. Hattie intervenes to stop Danny from leaving Sam by handcuffing herself to Sam after a wild party with White Lightning.
Confusion ensues when Hattie misunderstands Linda during a conversation about celibacy; Danny fears that his mother may be prostituting herself.
A guys' night out goes awry, resulting in lost recollections due to alcohol-fueled blackouts and the disappearance of Nick's wedding ring.
Nick attends his high-school reunion but must face an embarrassing incident from his past. Meanwhile, Lindsey throws a party.
Nick suffers a concussion.
Nick worries about his mortality and creates a bucket list featuring overly dangerous activities. Meanwhile, Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy ring at school.
Nick meets a famous actor, who shadows Nick in preparation for a role. Meanwhile, Kevin gears up for a spelling bee.
Nick is enlisted to host a charity walkathon. Meanwhile, Marilyn's bracelet goes missing, and the children train for their participation in the charity walk.
Nick and others enter a contest to win a house.
A new morning show is launched at the station, but Nick must cohost it with a self-serving reality star. Meanwhile, Marilyn moves in with the family.

2nd City and 9MAG participate in the Chicago Tattoo Convention, but tempers flare when ex-2nd City employees, Draya and Kitty, show up, creating conflict for Charmaine. Ryan plays peacemaker, but this comes at the cost of a personal relationship.

After the dysfunction at 2nd City Ink was put on display at the convention, the crew is scrambling to understand what happened and if the situation can be fixed. Meanwhile, Ryan is welcoming a new artist to 9MAG and searching for answers of his own.
Self-care is what it's all about as Ryan steps away from 9MAG to take part in an intensive therapy retreat, Don throws a community health fair, and Charmaine is faced with another family tragedy.

Neek tries to brighten Charmaine's spirits after losing her father by arranging a surprise picnic for their fifth anniversary. Charmaine reveals some big news. Ryan, fresh out of therapy and feeling brand new, approaches leadership at 9MAG with new vigor.

Sky goes under the knife to get the body she's been wanting since she was a teenager. Ceaser declares war when he finds out that Puma has opened a rival shop. Donna spills the beans about her night of passion with Dutchess.
Donna's allegations about Dutchess send shockwaves through the shop. Naeem introduces his girlfriend Alexis to the Art2Ink crew. Walt struggles with his new responsibilities as a full-time dad.

Ceaser confronts O'Sh*t about rumors that he had sex with Dutchess. Fists fly after Donna refuses to pay Sky her portion of the hotel bill. Puma's life flashes before his eyes when bullets are fired directly in to Art2Ink.

Sky hosts a butt reveal party at the shop. Ceaser stages a mediation as part of a last-ditch effort to broker peace between Kathie and O'Sh*t. After hearing about the shooting at Art2Ink, Puma's mother-in-law goes on the warpath

Dutchess spends her last days in NYC attempting to make amends with Donna. Kathie calls on her spirit guides to help her get revenge on O'Sh*t. Sky's past comes back to haunt her just as she's starting a new chapter in her life.

Dutchess faces a difficult decision when caterers, guests, and key supplies fall through. After she finds out her tattoo equipment was thrown out, Donna shows up unannounced in North Carolina to confront Dutchess and Ceaser.

Concerned that Dutchess is manipulating Ceaser, Caesar's mom tries to derail their marriage. Sky takes her new body out for a test drive. After becoming suspicious, Donna confronts Max's ex and gets an earful of information.

Sky is forced to make a life-altering decision. Puma's celebration turns ugly when Alexis confronts Donna about her past. When O'Sh*t blows off a client, Ceaser reaches his breaking point. Rah Ali shows up to Black Ink.

The crew heads north for some snow-tubing fun. O'Sh*t gets a grim warning from his doctor. Donna must make a decision about Max. Ceaser celebrates the new shop and O'Sh*t makes a decision that will change Black Ink forever.

Ceaser ushers in a new era of Black Ink at his new shop on 125th Street while Teddy takes the reins of 113th as the new executive manager. Donna finds out that her husband Max is still involved with his ex.

O'Sh*t returns to Harlem with a new name and a new flame. Ted transforms Ceaser's old office into a Boom Boom Room and hires a new tattoo artist with a questionable past. Ceaser's brand ambassador Kitty incites a brawl when she insults the 113th shop.

The Reagans confront hard choices on the job when Frank deals with a police captain who's losing his grip over his precinct, and Danny faces backlash from the Baez and Internal Affairs over a tough call he made in the field.

After Danny witnesses a drive-by shooting, he butts heads with the detective assigned to the case. Also, a childhood friend of Jamie's is convinced that she has single-handedly solved a cold case murder, and Frank struggles to trust an ex-detective.

Erin tries not to feel overpowered as her new boss shadows her at work just as shes trying to get a nervous eye-witness to reveal the identity of who shot her boyfriend. Also, the serial killer who previously held Danny and Baez hostage resurfaces.

Baez confides in Danny and asks for his help in proving her innocence after she finds a corpse in her front yard. Also, Erin struggles to find a peaceful solution when she receives harsh case notes from her boss.
Frank asks Erin to liaise between him and NY Governor Mendez regarding policy reform he privately backs, but can't publicly support, because it goes against police rank and file.
Frank takes matters into his own hands to save Gormley's career when the officer is accused of using excessive force after decades-old complaints against him become public knowledge.

Business becomes personal for Frank and his 1 Police Plaza team when Baker is assaulted on the street, as well as for Erin, when she asks her ex-husband, Jack Boyle (Peter Hermann), to represent a defendant she's prosecuting.
Jamie faces official reprimand from Frank when he refuses to explain why he contests the arrest report of a fellow officer assaulted in the field, a rising rookie with allies in City Hall.
Frank and the Deputy Commissioner of Press Information, Garrett Moore (Gregory Jbara), quarrel when Garrett refuses to walk back a quote he provided to a local newspaper.
Shockwaves ripple through the Reagan family when Danny discovers that their newest family member, Joe Hill (Will Hochman), is working undercover for the ATF to bring down a gunrunning organization.

The Reagans band together to prevent Joe Hill from being killed in the line of duty like his father when they fear Joe's cover has been blown within the gunrunning outfit he's helping the ATF bring down.
As Danny consults a psychic to solve the murder of a young boy, Frank is at odds with the mayor over how best to protect the city from an uptick in crime following a high-profile shooting.
Tension escalates between Frank and Mayor Chase (Dylan Walsh) after Frank makes a public arrest that goes viral.
Frank must decide between remaining police commissioner and pursuing a new professional chapter when his old friend Lenny Ross (Treat Williams) presents him with an exciting job offer.
Jamie faces backlash from fellow officers, when he partners with Erin and Anthony to investigate an underground bar the NYPD and FDNY use to hide their criminal indiscretions.
Hoss relies on clever attorney Whitney Parker, who has a drinking problem, to clear him of a murder charge.
Frank Medford, a figure from Ben's wild, misspent youth, shows up in Virginia City, and though down on his luck, creates troubles for the Cartwrights by claiming to be a successful businessman.
Outlaws capture Ben and hide him in an abandoned mine, holding him for a ransom. The boys must come up with a plan to save him before it's too late.
The peaceful world of a Ponderosa hand is disturbed by the arrival of his no-good father and twin brother, who is a wanted man.
An author is inspired to write about the heroic Cartwrights after watching first-hand as they fight off an attempted robbery of a stage.
After sitting on a jury that has convicted Terrence O' Tool of murder, Joe has second thoughts about the verdict and decides to do some investigating of his own.
Ladies' man Lothario Larkin creates havoc whenever he hits Virginia City, so Roy Coffee orders him out of town. Naturally, Hoss takes him in.
Hoss finds himself in another mess, this one involving a beautiful blonde, a moonshiner, and a nearsighted outlaw who is allergic to chocolate and flowers.
Joe has a run-in with Calamity Jane, and takes her home with him after promising her dying father to take care of her.

Dolly Bantree has a crooked manager Blackie, who blackmails Dolly to fleece newly rich miner Buford out of his newfound wealth. Hoss suspects something and gets all duded up to pose as a rich mark to test Dolly.
The Cartwrights' friendship with a neighboring rancher is threatened by his mentally unstable daughter.
After inadvertantly falling into the river, Adam is rescued by Tom Wilson. Wilson has feelings for Sue Miller, which bring him into trouble after her father is killed.
Hoss hires Waldo as a ranch hand after keeping Waldo from killing himself. Hoss soon learns that Waldo is lousy at his job and only causes problems for everyone else due to his clumsiness.
Not one, but three mail-order brides show up unexpectedly at the Ponderosa, all of them believing they are to marry Hoss.
A young troubadour, who blames Ben for the death of his father, returns to Virginia City. In one scene, Ben says the young man is welcome to use Adam's guitar.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.
Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow The Ghost and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent Ghost Incidents.
During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt.
The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't.
Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue, an enormous otherworldly beast, appears!

The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.
The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Bernie realizes he may have been too truthful when telling Jordan about his father; he amends the truth to make Jordan think well of his father.
Lovie wants answers after contracting an STD; if Courtney is Gloria's sister, then Gloria's father cheated on her mother.

Lisa advises the women to get back at their boyfriends for going to Las Vegas, so Lala, Katie and Ariana get cozy at Scheana's slumber party; Jax, Schwartz and Sandoval strive to remain loyal to their girlfriends while in Sin City.

Tom Sandoval and Tom Schwartz divulge shocking news about their trip to Las Vegas; Kristen returns to SUR, but Ariana is not ready to forgive; Tom Sandoval and Ariana take the stage at the Improv; James tries to sabotage Jax's love life.

Lisa Vanderpump holds Stassi at arm's length; Scheana and Ariana realize their friendship is damaged; James schemes to get an invitation to Hawaii with the others; Katie shows off her engagement ring at SUR; Faith and Lala go skinny-dipping.

The gang heads to Hawaii to celebrate Jax and Tom's birthdays; Tom learns Scheana sent derogatory text messages about him to Ariana's mother; Katie lashes out when Lala swims naked in front of Schwartz.
When Stassi visits Kristen, she reveals the truth about her sex tape; Ariana refuses to accept Scheana's apologies; Lala kicks James out of bed; Jax winds up in jail.

Accused of shoplifting, Jax must answer to the law, to his girlfriend and to Lisa Vanderpump; Stassi returns to SUR to repay Lisa for keeping the sex tape from leaking; James and Lala cannot keep their hands off each other during a photo shoot.

Katie launches her Website with a party, but a surprise appearance by James and a text message from Stassi threaten to ruin the event; Jax adjusts to life as an unemployed outlaw while Brittany adjusts to her new life as sole breadwinner.

When Stassi runs into her former crew members at Lala's house party, Scheana must finally answer for her part in Stassi's sex tape scandal; Jax brags about his girlfriend's breast enhancement; Tom Schwartz lands in hot water after he quits his job.

Jax's girlfriend, Brittany, undergoes breast augmentation surgery; Lisa is faced with a big decision after James makes a scene at PUMP; Tom Sandoval removes the tattoo on his buttocks; Ariana makes a stunning statement at Katie's beach party.

Against Lisa's advice, Katie surprises Stassi in Palm Springs, Calif.; James convinces himself that Kristen is the answer to his problems; Scheana worries about losing her friends; Jax, Tom Schwartz and Peter try their hands at babysitting.

Katie begs to hold her engagement party at Villa Rosa, but Lisa Vanderpump balks because Stassi and Kristen are on the guest list; Jax questions everything as his court date gets closer; Tom Sandoval shoots a video to launch his music career.

El hermano de Laura y Alan es violador y delincuente, ella lo encubre. Por otro lado, Maritza perdió un brazo en boca de un cocodrilo y ahora es activista por la protección de esta especie.
Bryan está obsesionado con los muñecos, contrata a Antonio para que sea el Ken de su esposa. Anthony trae a su novia de Nueva York para celebrar su cumpleaños, pero se pone celoso de un chico.

Jenny se emborrachó introduciéndose tampones con alcohol en la vagina. Por otro lado, Javier es bromista y por un chiste de mal gusto, Lola lo despidió de su asociación.

Ella quiere que su pareja deje de consumir morning glory. Él alega que la sustancia mejora su productividad. Alexander perdió la custodia de su hijo al entrar en prisión. El menor se suicidó.

p.t: Blue Bloods, en español: Secretos de familia
p.d: Después de obtener una coincidencia de un pariente desconocido de una red de ADN, Sean Reagan investiga para averiguar quién podría ser esta persona misteriosa.

El equipo se dirige a las playas de California tras la aparición de varios cadáveres en torres de salvamento en la costa. Deberán averiguar que tienen los cuerpos en común y quién ha podido hacerlo. Por otro lado, Hotch invita a Beth a salir.

La UAC investiga una serie de brutales robos y asesinatos en hogares de Inland Empire, en California. Al parecer, se trata de ataques relacionados con bandas callejeras, pero la investigación pronto arroja una motivación aún más siniestra.
El equipo viaja a Atlanta para investigar el asesinato de una mujer, descubriendo que el criminal no trabaja solo.

Varias parejas que están en proceso de adoptar niños en Seattle empiezan a ser asesinadas. La UAC busca a un criminal que tiene un perfil muy pronunciado de instinto maternal, aunque asesino. Por otro lado, García tiene miedo de hablar con Kevin.
El asesinato de un suboficial naval revela una sorprendente conexión con la decisión del director Vance de disolver el equipo, poniendo en riesgo su futuro y la resolución del caso.

Tony está investigando a un marinero que podría haber saltado por la borda. Le pide a Gibbs que informe a la viuda. Pero cuando descubren que ella ha sido asesinada, todo el equipo tendrá que intervenir para descubrir qué es lo que realmente pasó.
Cuando el senador Patrick Kiley pide la ayuda de Gibbs para resolver el asesinato de un joven oficial naval, el equipo de NCIS se ve inmerso en el complicado mundo de la política de Washington.
Mientras buscan al brutal asesino de un marine, el equipo de NCIS y Gibbs se encuentran enfrentándose nuevamente al agente del FBI Fornell.
Amidst a shifting political climate, Frank goes head to head with City Council Speaker Regina Thomas (Whoopi Goldberg) over protests against police brutality.
Danny and Jamie combine forces to convict a notorious drug lord, as Erin nervously awaits the Governor's selection for the new District Attorney.

When Joe Hill's lineage as a Reagan is revealed, Frank struggles from a distance when his grandson wants to fight his own battles. Also, Danny's opposition to authority clashes with Jamie's adherence to the rules, as both brothers work to solve a murder.

Frank must decide whether the department can accommodate a request to remain in the field from Detective Allison Mulaney (Ali Stroker), a lauded cop who is wheelchair-bound after being wounded in the line of duty.

El equipo se dirige a las playas de California tras la aparición de varios cadáveres en torres de salvamento en la costa. Deberán averiguar que tienen los cuerpos en común y quién ha podido hacerlo. Por otro lado, Hotch invita a Beth a salir.

Influenciada por los consejos de Ollita y por las demostraciones de amor de Pedro, Celia está dispuesta a hacer públicas sus intenciones de establecer el comienzo de una relación consentida.
Sin poder convencer a su padre de que regrese a la casa, Celia se encuentra además con un Simón agresivo y resentido, quien termina demostrándole que tiene otra mujer y una vida plagada de excesos.
Mientras Lola vive un nuevo aire en New York y encuentra por fin una persona en la que supuestamente puede confiar, Celia planea una de las noches más felices de su vida que se torna en tristeza.
Después de superar sus miedos ante la presencia del babalao, Celia se adentra en un mundo plagado de convicciones africanas, y siente la revelación de encontrar su esencia y su mundo.
La relación entre Pedro y Celia ya no tiene remedio, y aunque en el fondo ella lo ame, no puede admitir que las mentiras de Pedro le sigan arruinando su vida.
Después de haber sobrevivido a la gran ciudad, Lola se atreve a llamar a su padrastro solo para recordarle que jamás volverá. Eliécer hará hasta lo imposible por sacarle a Celia la información.
Por más de que su corazón le pide a gritos que vuelva con Pedro, Celia se niega rotundamente a sus sentimientos, y está convencida de que lo mejor es alejarse de él por siempre.
Mientras Celia sufre en México, en La Habana los barbudos han llegado a la casa de ella para informarle que desde ese momento la propiedad pasa a ser un resguardo de las tropas revolucionarias.
Pedro le sigue insistiendo a Celia para que vaya a cantar con la Sonora, pero ella se niega a hacerles pleitesía a los comandantes, inclusive sabiendo que su casa puede estar en peligro.
Después del enfrentamiento de Pérez Roura con el Che, los barbudos le van a dar la lección de su vida, y lo secuestran. Por su lado, Celia también firma su sentencia.
Rogelio Martínez está decidido, y discretamente le informa a Pedro, Caíto y René que después de la gira en México jamás volverán a Cuba.
Alberto queda impactado con la noticia que le da Gamita, pero por el aprecio que le tiene promete ayudarlo. Sin embargo, Alberto se ve presionado por Lilo Candela.
Gamita sufre lo indecible en la celda con los barbudos, pero antes de poder ser víctima de una tortura atroz, Ollita, Ana y Noris se las ingenian y llegan hasta la celda de la tortura.
Después de una conversación con el Presidente, Celia decide que se extienda el plazo para quedarse en México con la Sonora, pensando en que es lo mejor para la orquesta.
Lola recibe la noticia de que Billy no está muerto, y puede volver a respirar tranquila. Mongo y Tico no piensan desampararla, y se quedan para acompañarla con Eliécer.

Mannix gets an urgent call from the police. Lt. Art Malcolm, Mannix's friend who also served with the detective during the Korean War, is being held hostage in an abandoned building.

Barnaby Jones uncovers a seamy world of adultery and corruption when he investigates a couple of suspicious deaths where the perpetrator appears to be a young boy's beloved pet dog.

The assassination of one of Honolulu's most active flesh peddlers threatens an all-out war between two competing vice empires and brings McGarrett and the governor's office into action to avert gang-style warfare.
A series of cleaning store robberies exposes the chain's owner as the decoy for a money laundering conspiracy and causes suspicion from his very dangerous partners.

A former boyfriend of Alex is in trouble when a prison is released from jail, waiting for a new trial. The crime boss is killing the witnesses that put him in prison in the first place. Walker must save the witness so he can testify again.

An Irish peacemaker visits Texas to talk about a plan to unify Ireland. Irish militants attempt an assassination. One of the militants is captured and the rest of the team attempt a rescue as well as continue the assassination attempts.

In the '60s, Johnny Carson becomes the undisputed king of late night.
In the 1980s, David Letterman reinvents late night for a new generation.
Johnny Carson's 1992 retirement kicks off an epic late-night war.
As the 2000s unfold, diverse voices emerge, while others take on the news.
Late-night TV confronts its biggest identity crisis in a generation.
As a child, the Highlands were a place where Alan Cumming went to escape.
Burnt out and disillusioned, Taraji P. Henson fled to Bali to recharge.
College student Brad Perry shows up to work his graveyard shift at the gas station and is never seen alive again.
When 25-year-old school teacher Christy Mirack is found murdered in her apartment in 1992, there is no shortage of suspects.

Just two years into their marriage, Chuck and Cheryl Hall are torn apart when Chuck finds Cheryl murdered. Though Cheryl's family is certain they know her killer, the law isn't as sure. After several decades, a DNA match erases all doubt.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo. A closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

When 36-year-old computer programmer Lisa Valdez fails to show up for work, her apartment manager finds her brutally murdered. Detectives ask, could she be the victim of a brutal serial killer? Or was Lisa murdered by someone she knew?

A forensic dentist helps police nab a child killer by showing that the teeth marks on the killer's arms match the teeth of the murdered boy. And telltale blood stains on a blue bandana solve the 10-year-old case of a teenage girl murdered.

DNA found on a marijuana joint in Florida in 2005 helps to solve the 1988 rape and murder of a California woman. And a cold case of murder in Illinois heats up when a jailhouse lawyer turns jailhouse snitch.

Police run down more than 11,000 leads before coming up with a suspect in the murders of three Virginia girls, and the abduction and strangulation of a California woman continue to baffle the investigators more than 11 years after the crime.
Forty-one years after the crime, a woman implicates her brother and cousin in the murder of a policeman.

Easter Sunday of 1992, the body of missing woman Lisa Ziegert is found in a field. The investigation yields hundreds of leads but no true suspect. After more than two decades on ice, the case is revived.

Cops finally close in on a serial killer with the help of the Internet. And a drug trafficker jumps bail goes into the bike shop business and helps pioneer the sport of mountain biking while he's on the lam.

When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August of 1986, residents of Tacoma panic. This is the second young girl killed in five months. Convinced a predator is loose, Police embark on a 32-year inquiry.

This is the story of the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in American history--the BTK killer. After committing at least seven brutal murders he vanished for over 25 years before sending clues of his crimes to the media in 2004.
A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.
El techo del baño se cae y Eli se hace cargo del arreglo. Los marqueses la engañan para que les deje hacer la obra y sacar un dinero extra, pero ellos no tienen ni idea de albañilería.
Daria acompaña a Jane a comprar pinturas al supermercado y se encuentran también a Kevin y Brittany. Tom necesita hablar con Jane y Trent lo lleva hasta la gran tienda.
¿Es Lawndale un bonito y pequeño vecindario, o un nexo del mal embrujado por las almas en pena del más allá? Se conocen en este capítulo tres leyendas urbanas de Lawndale.

Quinn salva su vida milagrosamente cuando cae una lámpara en la silla de la que se encontraba sentada y cree tener un ángel de la guarda. Eso la lleva a descubrir su lado espiritual y toda la familia va a tener que aprender a soportarlo.

Cuando Jake sufre un pequeño contratiempo en la cocina, de tipo infernal los Morgendorffer tienen que mudarse a un hotel ya que se incendia la casa. Pero Daria decide ir a pasar unos días con Jane y empieza a llevarse bien con Tom.

Daria ayuda a pintar el cabello de Jane, lo cual es un desastre, pero los resultados no son tan buenos como ellas esperaban y terminan discutiendo sobre su relación con Tom. Tom y Daria comparten un beso en el auto de Tom.
Cuando la escuela de Lawndale sufre una crisis económica, la cura puede ser peor que la enfermedad. La locura se produce cuando la señora Li firma un contrato con una compañía de gaseosas.
Cuando Daria ve que su hermana recibe un montón de regalos de sus citas, Quinn busca la fecha en la que por primera vez Daria salió con Tom y ese sería el día de su aniversario.

El club de la moda se desploma en crisis por lo impensable, unos kilos de más. Sandi tiene un accidente que la deja en muletas, y luego la hace engordar. Finalmente renuncia al club de modas, Quinn también, y por último Stacy y Tiffany.

Si eres un jugador, eres un deportista, simple lógica. Puedes ser un ágil jugador de fútbol, un talentoso jugador de tenis, o ser como ella, que siempre gana jugando con tus sentimientos. Dale play a estos sketches y descubre tu deporte favorito.
El mejor momento del año es cuando llegan las vacaciones, y que mejor que disfrutarlas en la playa.
Divertirse a veces es más difícil de lo que parece, como al final desilusionarte porque ella te ha engañado.
El bosque, un parque o la montaña son excelentes destinos para vacacionar, aunque sea con la carpa rota.
En este nuevo episodio de Bar Central: Macario, Fran Hevia y Diego Zanassi disfrutarán de la hora feliz de la comedia junto a Franco Escamilla.
En este nuevo episodio de Bar Central: Gon Curiel, Bubu Romo y Alex Marín y Kall disfrutarán de la hora feliz de la comedia junto a Franco Escamilla.
Helen agrees to help her niece with her divorce, Jake leaves home to escape Helen and Aunt Rita's bickering, Daria avoids Tom, and Stacy and Tiffany face a fashion dilemma.
Abbi and Ilana list their apartments on BAndB-NYC to make some extra cash.
Ilana's parents come to the city for their 30th anniversary, but Abbi and Ilana find it hard to celebrate when they both experience relationship problems.

When the batteries in Sarah's TV remote die, she embarks on an odyssey to find new ones; Brian and Steve discuss politics.
The guys accept a babysitting gig without realizing that Adam has dosed their smoothies with peyote.
In a flashback to 2008, the guys experience their first day at TelAmeriCorp and help Alice get a leg up at the company.
When TelAmeriCorp starts selling more female-friendly products, the women in the office are promoted and start wielding their new power over the men.
Adam and Ders struggle to get back into the dating game, and Jillian and Blake discover that co-parenting a cat is more responsibility than they can handle.
After a special adult video the guys order goes missing, they must embark on a quest to find the package before it's too late.
When a social media expert comes to the office, the guys compete to hone their personal brands.
Andre and Meegan have a serious talk, a rapper runs into trouble while trying to storm out of an interview, and an airline passenger adapts to life in economy plus.
Ghostbusters singer Ray Parker Jr. unveils his lesser-known songs, a young man is transported to a magical land, and Jordan and Keegan reach their final destination.
Jordan and Keegan trade stories about a forbidden word, while President Obama's anger gets translated.
President Obama rap battles, and a traffic reporter has some trouble flying.
Shawntia has over $13,000 worth of debt because of her husband, Ian's gambling obsession! Ian is a self-purported Parlay King and has no intentions of stopping now.
Lex is about to meet her mother, Chrissy and sister Marquita for the first time. Lex needs to know why Chrissy abandoned her when she was a child.
Wilda is suing her neighbor for the cost of stolen speakers and $3,000 for harassment.
Kevin wants his ex-fiancé to pay him back for a loan he gave her to pay off her credit card.
Arthur is suing his ex-fiancé for the price of her engagement ring after she refused to return it.

Sean and his girlfriend Lanika deny that he is the father of Rebecca's baby. Then, Kyrstal and Precious want to prove that their brother London did not father Paula's baby. Teen mom Alicia cheated on Tony, but doesn't know if he's the baby's father!

Today on MAURY, Brian, his mom, and his sister all deny Sarah's baby. Then, Robert always wanted a dad, but James always denied him. Plus its grandmother verses grandmother in DNA war that spans generations!

Nick denies Chantelle's baby, but she wants to prove he's the father and make him pay up. Mario's mother Evette says she went undercover to prove that Sierra cheated on her son and that he is not her baby's father! What will the DNA results reveal?
Furious mom Patty wants to prove that her daughter’s boyfriend Dale, a man twice her daughter’s age, has been cheating. Then did Bam cheat on Brianna in his own bed?
Keisha knows that Desmond fathered her baby, but he wants her out of his life! Then, 2 desperate moms confront the man who fathered their 3 kids!
Kiki and her sister Sad-e swear that Kiki’s boyfriend Tavon is a cheater. What will they say when he is caught on our hidden camera? Then, are James’ kids with Nikkie actually his?
Did Pastor Terry’s wife cheat on him with 200 different men? Then Naomi wants to find out if her fiancé Jesse is a cheater. What will the results reveal on Maury today?

Jay claims he's not the father of Tanelle's babies. Jennifer says that Thomas is the father, but he's engaged to her cousin and says she's got it wrong. Plus, Josh doubts that he's fathered Angela's twins. But could he have fathered only one twin?

These girls got on the wrong path and are convinced that their mothers don't deserve their respect. Some have had babies and are ready to have more. But MAURY and his team of experts are here to try and set these girls back on the right track.

The last time Crystal was here, she got a DNA denial, but is back to test another potential father. Then, Aaron and his new girlfriend say there's no way Aaron is the father of Marissa's baby. What truths will the DNA results reveal?

Officers are left to solve the crime after signs of an apparent stabbing. A man loiters in a private park. A driver insists that the car is his - even though he needs a screwdriver to start the ignition and the plates are stolen.

A teenager who ran away from home tries running from the cops too. A man set a date to turn his life around, but deputies ask him to start earlier. A man found with hundreds of sunglasses claims he was going to give them away.
Police investigate suspicious activity in a known drug area, officers encounter a jaywalker with the munchies, and a woman caught with meth wants points for honesty.

A man arrested on warrants just wants his wife, a vagrant is caught on camera stealing from a liquor store, and officers check on a woman asleep on the side of the road.

Officers engage in a highspeed pursuit of a stolen vehicle. Police contact the Fire Department and alert the guests when they spot a motel fire. Officers pursue a suspect on a stolen motorcycle.
A man involved in a drug deal claims he works for the task force. An irate woman slams the front door when officers arrive. Police pull over two young suspects in an area known for drug activity.

Officers utilize the help of the K-9 unit to find a suspect hiding in a shed. A cooperative suspect is faced with a list of charges. A motorcycle chase comes to an end after the suspect ditches the stolen bike and attempts to flee on foot.
After a 25-year-old landscape architect is murdered along a roadside, police receive an anonymous tip that leads them to the killer.

A strangler has killed several elderly women in Mexico City; there is no connection between the victims and no discernible motive; after the police investigation comes to nothing, the killer is suddenly caught red-handed.
When elderly women are murdered in an upscale gated community, detectives uncover a trail of credit card fraud that leads them to the killer.
When a young woman disappears from the streets of Southampton, England, police launch a massive manhunt; the killer is one step ahead and flees to India, with the victim's parents hot on his heels.

A self-proclaimed doctor in Florida specializes in buttock enhancements; this medical unprofessional injects tire-sealant, bathtub caulk and liquid cement into her patients, with homicidal consequences.

The team gains a new, familiar, member and some growing pains while trying to find the latest victim of a killer who puts up wanted posters of his victims before he abducts them.
The BAU travels to Portland to investigate a suspected gang of murderers targeting a new victim each night.

As a favor to the D.A. in Boston, Hotchner and Rossi profile a woman who murdered her husband, though the D.A. may not like their findings. Back at the office, J.J.'s personalization of a stalker case baffles the rest of the team.
A truck driver is kidnapping women and disposing of them in random locations and the BAU must find out his motive in order to catch him.

The team investigates when a wealthy couple is murdered in their own home after a Super Bowl party and learns that someone placed an emergency call to quote Bible passages in the seconds before the murders.
The BAU go to Detroit to catch a man who burns his victims alive during the pre-Halloween celebration Devil's Night.
The BAU is called to a North Carolina mountain town after a woman is found badly injured and another is missing, and they discover that these two are not the only victims.
When bodies begin turning up in the cornfields of Indiana, the team must catch a pack of serial killers targeting exotic dancers.
The BAU investigates a group of suspects with a pack mentality who are randomly selecting their victims in the nation's capital and murdering them for the thrill of it.

The BAU team investigates a string of brutal bludgeonings in Philadelphia and is led to the city's boxing scene in search of the killer. Also, Hotch makes a connection with an attractive runner as they both train for a triathlon.

A family consisting of two parents and their son break into a home, kill the parents and kidnap their daughter. As the investigation proceeds, the BAU team begin to suspect that what they're dealing with is bigger than they thought.
The BAU is called to San Francisco to investigate a possible Zodiac Killer copycat. Meanwhile, Reid wonders what he's done in his life as he reaches 30.
Following a 20-year period of silence, a serial killer re-emerges, contacting the BAU with a guarantee to kill another victim before five days are up.
A series of rolling blackouts in the city of Los Angeles lures a serial killer out of hiding, giving him renewed opportunities to continue his killing spree.
The BAU team searches for a serial killer who is preying on married couples. Also, Hotchner looks to one of the team to fill JJ's vacant role.
Tohru, the Somas, and all of their friends prepare for the next chapters of their lives.
The resistance fighters enter a village hostile to their cause; Lunk tries to deliver a manuscript to a dead comrade's father.
The resistance discovers a camp run by Col. Wolfe, an inspirational member of the Earth Reclamation Forces, but after an Invid attack, Rand discovers Wolfe's troubling secret.

Miss Kobayashi is surprised by Tohru's social skills when she sees how friendly Tohru was with the people of the shopping district; Tohru makes the dark claim that she's pretending to be friendly, and that she still doesn't understand human emotions.
Kanna starts living with Tohru and Miss Kobayashi; while the livelier residence is nice, sharing a tiny apartment with three people becomes cramped, so Miss Kobayashi decides to move.

Kanna watched the elementary school kids going to school with jealousy, so Miss Kobayashi decides to let Kanna attend elementary school; Miss Kobayashi, Tohru, and Kanna all set out to the shopping district in order to buy Kanna's school supplies.

Tohru's finally gotten the hang of her maid duties; suddenly interested in what Miss Kobayashi does at work, she heads out to observe; there, she watches how everyone relies on Miss Kobayashi and falls for her again.

Kanna is invited to Saikawa's home; since Saikawa's family has a maid too, they invite Miss Kobayashi and Tohru to join her; when a genuine maid, Josie, greets them, Miss Kobayashi gets excited, and the two hit it off, chatting about maids.

Miss Kobayashi and the others go to the beach, but Lucoa's immediately dragged off by one of the lifeguards for her skimpy swimsuit; after regrouping, they put sunscreen on each other, split a watermelon, go swimming together, and enjoy summer.
Kanna asks Miss Kobayashi to make her a lunch box for her field trip; after Tohru says to leave it to her, the two break out into a match to see who's better at it.

It's Kanna's sports festival but when she learns Miss Kobayashi is too busy at work to go, she sulks; Miss Kobayashi wonders why she'd want her to go so badly when she isn't Kanna's parent, but Kanna already views her as one.

En 1999, una niña de 12 años fue encontrada asesinada en su casa y cambió la sensación de seguridad que tenían los residentes de la pequeña ciudad de Waseca, Minnesota.
En el 2007, Shamaia Smith desaparece de un club de striptease en East Hartford, Connecticut. La policía considera varios patrones del club, pero se enfocan en un comerciante local, Kenneth Otto.
Se sospecha un juego sucio cuando Glenda Furch, una trabajadora de una fábrica de Fort Worth, desaparece después de completar su turno.
El sospechoso principal tenía un historial criminal y su licencia de conducir se encontró en la escena del crimen de un brutal homicidio doble.
Una adolescente de Modesto, California desapareció. No había señales de lucha en su casa y la policía sospechaba que ella simplemente se había escapado.
Un niño de quince años muere a causa de una misteriosa herida de bala en la cabeza mientras está sentado en el vestíbulo del club de armas de su padre.
Dos hombres diferentes llamaron a la policía para denunciar el mismo asesinato. Al parecer, ninguno sabía que el otro había llamado. La investigación descubrió circunstancias aún más inusuales.
La policía de California tenía varios sospechosos en el robo y brutal asesinato de una pareja de ancianos.
Una talentosa presentadora de noticias de televisión fue asesinada a tiros fuera de su casa; parecía ser un crimen pasional, perpetrado por un fanático obsesionado.

Un estudiante de posgrado de la Universidad Estatal de Michigan desapareció y se presumió muerto. Con la ayuda de un profesor de ciencias geológicas, la policía esperaba obtener información de su asesino.

Se encuentra a Nancy Newman y a sus dos hijas que fueron brutalmente asesinadas. La escena del crimen no tiene escasez de pruebas, pero los investigadores no pueden encontrar un vínculo concluyente con su principal sospechoso.
Cuando se encuentra a un popular profesor de gimnasia muerto por lo que parece ser una herida de bala accidental, su familia se pone sospechosa.
Cuando Rosemary Anderson es encontrada muerta a un lado de la carretera, su novio se convierte en el principal sospechoso.
Una investigación de asesinato en Florida atraviesa jurisdicciones de New York y Jamaica.

En este episodio clásico de Archivos Forenses la serie de crímenes reales más extensa de la historia de la televisión, Eileen y Derrick Severs desaparecen de su casa en un pequeño pueblo de Gran Bretaña y la policía encuentra evidencia de un crimen.
Una pareja que sale de un restaurante en su aniversario es asesinada en la calle y su coche es robado. La escena del crimen se ve comprometida cuando llueve poco después de que lleguen los CSI.
Todo el equipo investiga el secuestro del hijo pequeño de una familia acomodada. Las sospechas recaen inmediatamente sobre los padres del niño.
Dos adolescentes atropellan con su coche a un sordo, pero no lo matan: ya estaba muerto.

Grissom, Nick y Warrick toman el caso de un corredor que fue asesinado por un animal salvaje en el parque. La cosa se complica cuando descubren que al corredor le extirparon el hígado después de matarlo.

El día que Grissom tiene que evaluar a su equipo, se encuentra una cabeza en el maletero de un coche. Mientras Gil y Catherine trabajan en la cabeza, Sara y Nick investigan un cadáver en el desierto al que le falta la cabeza.
El equipo investiga los continuos asesinatos cometidos por un asesino de firma. El asesino tiene ciertos conocimientos forenses y ha dejado pocas pruebas.
Grissom y su equipo son llamados después de que Tony Braun, un conocido drogadicto, es encontrado muerto en su casa por un jardinero.
Todo el equipo de CSI investiga una desaparición en una universidad local.
Grissom investiga un posible suicidio en una obra de gran envergadura.
Cuando el payaso de la clase del instituto local aparece asesinado, se llama al equipo de CSI para que investigue.
Grissom, Sara y Warrick son llamados para investigar un apartamento abandonado salpicado de sangre y Nick y Catherine deben examinar a un submarinista muerto alojado en un árbol.

Grissom y su equipo investigan a un sospechoso de asesinato al que pillan in fraganti enterrando a las víctimas, mientras Catherine y Warrick se encargan del caso de una mujer encontrada muerta en el spa de un hotel.
Grissom y Nick investigan la muerte de un restaurador de libros mientras Catherine y Sara son llamadas al lugar de un accidente de tren mortal.
Grissom y Catherine investigan la aparente muerte violenta de una mujer encontrada en un arenero. Su investigación les lleva al mundo clandestino de los clubes de s y m.

Grissom y su equipo investigan un atraco a un casino durante el cual se disparó a víctimas inocentes, mientras que Catherine y Sara son llamadas a la escena de un asesinato en un lugar remoto del desierto.
A casino employee is beaten and raped on her way home from work, but she survives and identifies her attacker.
Our forensic team is back together again, with Grissom and Catherine leading in three fantastic forensic mysteries.
In an upstairs/downstairs-type investigation, the CSIs look into solving two forensic mysteries.
Our CSIs attempt to determine there was foul play in a housewife's fall down the stairs.
A middle of the night break-in in a suburban home on the edge of the Vegas desert reveals a body dump.
A family of four is brutally murdered in their own home.
CSI determines a young mother's suicide was actually foul play.
A routine traffic stop turns into a wild police chase through the streets of a Las Vegas Latino ghetto.
Evidence points to Sofia as the shooter who accidentally shot another officer.
On Thanksgiving night, a man is found dead in a dumpster behind a restaurant.
A widowed mother's six-year-old son is reported kidnapped from a local park.
CSI investigates the murder of a man who was covered in hair from head to toe and shot in the heart with a silver bullet.
The CSI team is brought into the world of tweakers and methamphetamines.
The CSIs enter the world of glamorous old Vegas.
CSI investigates two deaths, both linked to the same killer.
En los Everglades, cerca de un incendio controlado, Alexx y Delko registran la escena del crimen. Se ven obligados a protegerse cuando un muro de fuego los alcanza.
Horatio llega rápidamente al lugar cuando asaltan a un camión blindado que transporta 3.2 millones de dólares en un atrevido atraco en el centro de la ciudad.
Wally Shmagin se convierte literalmente en parte de la escena de un crimen después de robar un guante de látex para agregarlo a su colección forense personal.
Un periodista escurridizo es el único testigo de un asesinato y Horatio sospecha que puede estar buscando una historia mucho más importante.
Cuando asesinan a tiros a un oficial de policía mientras estaba en el trabajo, el equipo de CSI rastrea a los que él vio esa noche y se entera de que recogió a una prostituta.
El equipo de CSI investiga las vidas de quienes viven en un aeroparque de lujo después de que una avioneta se estrella en un lugar popular de Miami Beach.
Encuentran muerto a un guardia de seguridad después de que suenan disparos en el concierto de la estrella del rap 10-Large y llaman al equipo de CSI para investigar.
Cuando la evidencia de una investigación de asesinato lleva al equipo de CSI a creer que el asesino puede estar en Nueva York, Horatio lleva su investigación a la Gran Manzana.
Encuentran estrangulada a una actriz de cine para adultos en el parque y llaman al equipo de CSI para investigar y encontrar al asesino.
Una peligrosa investigación lleva al equipo de CSI por un camino traicionero que conducirá a la trágica pérdida de uno de los suyos.
La vida de Yelina está en peligro cuando Horatio y el equipo de CSI trabajan en un caso para condenar a un rapero sospechoso de un tiroteo al estilo de Miami desde un auto en movimiento.
Un flash mob surge en un campo de golf privado, ¿el grupo de estudiantes estaba allí para esconder un cuerpo o para dejar uno?
Empujan a una mujer frente a un tren en movimiento del metro de Miami y tanto su novio como la exnovia acosadora son sospechosos de su asesinato.
El ambiente de discoteca de Miami se vuelve mortal cuando el consumo de alcohol por parte de menores provoca un sangriento asesinato en un baño, Horatio y el equipo de CSI investigan.
Un viaje de campo del jurado a la escena de un asesinato provoca un vuelco legal cuando el acusado termina muerto y los doce miembros del jurado se convierten en los principales sospechosos.
When a man, Juan Marco Varon, who may or may not have tortured Cuban refuges is murdered, the CSIs are called in to investigate.
Horatio and his team delve into the world of celebrity and investigate the murder of a paparazzi. He discovers the victim witnessed another murder.
Ted Henderson is killed in his own home and his body is missing, while his wife and son are left alive, but beaten and bound.
In the Everglades, near a controlled burn, Alexx and Delko search the crime scene. They are forced to take cover when a wall of fire overtakes them.
Horatio is quick to arrive on the scene when an armored truck carrying 3.2 million dollars is robbed in a daring downtown heist.
Wally Shmagin literally becomes part of a murder crime scene after he steals a latex glove to add to his personal forensic collection.
A slippery journalist is the only witness to a murder, and Horatio suspects that he may be looking for a much bigger story.
When a police officer is shot to death while on the job, the CSIs track who he saw while that night and learn that he picked-up a call girl.
CSIs investigate the lives of those living in a high-end airpark after a prop plane crashes into a local Miami beach hot spot.
A security guard is found dead after shots ring out at rap star 10-Large’s concert and the CSI are called in to investigate.
When evidence at a murder investigation leads the CSIs to believe the killer may be in NYC, Horatio takes his investigation to the Big Apple.
An adult film actress is found strangled to death in the park and the CSIs are called in to investigate and find the killer.
As Delko's life hangs in the balance, Horatio flashes back 12 years to reveal how Miami's CSIs first met and became a team.
When the lab is attacked, Horatio must fulfill a gunman's unique request in order to save five hostages, including new CSI Jesse Cardoza.
Three volleyball players mysteriously drop dead on the court, while Calleigh's testimony against Delko threatens his future as a CSI.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: ¡Déjenme salir! (S8 Ep6)
p.d: El equipo de CSI investiga cuando una broma de fraternidad en el Día de Brujas sale mal y un maestro de ceremonias es dado por muerto en una tumba abierta.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Juego siniestro (S8 Ep7)
p.d: El equipo de CSI investiga cuando la noticia de una fiesta en una escuela secundaria se vuelve viral, lo que da lugar a una aglomeración, un porche colapsado y la muerte de una adolescente.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Intercepción (S8 Ep8)
p.d: Mientras el equipo de CSI de Nueva York investiga el asesinato de un juez, Jo se encuentra cara a cara con un criminal de su pasado.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: 48 horas antes (S8 Ep9)
p.d: Cuando un testigo importante aparece muerto, Jo se ve envuelta en la peligrosa investigación del presunto violador que liberaron cuando ella trabajaba en Washington D.C.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Sin rastro alguno (S8 Ep10)
p.d: Un cuerpo carbonizado se convierte en un desastre para el equipo de CSI cuando comienza a parecer que un luchador de artes marciales mixtas ha sido asesinado por su acosador.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: ¿Quién está ahí? (S8 E11)
p.d: Una investigación de violación de domicilio se vuelve más complicada cuando la familia de la víctima resulta ser menos perfecta de lo que parecía originalmente.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Brooklyn hasta la muerte (S8 E12)
p.d: Un juego de rol se vuelve letal cuando un jugador es víctima de un asesino auténtico y el otro es secuestrado para pedir un rescate.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: El efecto dominó (S8 Ep13)
p.d: Cuando el equipo de CSI investiga dos muertes aparentemente sin relación, sus rastros separados de evidencias conducen a una conclusión que sorprendentemente las vincula.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Fin del juego (S8 Ep14)
p.d: El equipo de CSI se encuentra inmerso en el mundo de los videojuegos competitivos cuando descubre que un asesinato puede estar relacionado con un torneo de altas apuestas.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Caso cerrado (S8 Ep15)
p.d: Asesinan a un técnico de laboratorio en un caso que se parece a otro sin resolver de la década de 1950, el equipo de CSI vislumbra lo que sucede en las sombras del laboratorio.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Salud (S8 Ep16)
p.d: Una ola de brutalidad amenaza a una pequeña comunidad de la ciudad de Nueva York cuando encuentran un cuerpo descuartizado y estratégicamente abandonado en cuatro esquinas.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Obsequio de cumpleaños (S8 Ep17)
p.d: Llaman al equipo de CSI a un proyecto de viviendas en Brooklyn para investigar el asesinato de un exitoso empresario que se sintió atraído por su antiguo vecindario.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Cerca de la muerte (S8 Ep18)
p.d: Cuando Mac recibe un disparo, se encuentra en el limbo entre la vida y la muerte, mientras lucha por su vida, su equipo debe llevar al tirador ante la justicia.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Reavivó (S9 Ep1)
p.d: El equipo de CSI investiga cuando un jefe de bomberos, amigo de Mac, muere en un incendio provocado con la técnica que usó un pirómano recientemente liberado bajo palabra.

p.t: CSI: New York en español: Donde hubo fuego… (S9 Ep2)
p.d: El equipo de CSI de Nueva York se apresura para detener al pirómano en serie Leonard Brooks después de que empieza a usar el fuego contra personas de su oscuro pasado.
After a young woman and a prominent judge are murdered, the CSI team works to discover the connection between the two crimes.
The CSI team investigates the death of a street luger and the mysterious drowning of a woman in a self-sanitizing pay bathroom.
When a trained female assassin comes to New York City, she really puts the CSI New York team members’ abilities to the test.
The kidnapping of a little girl and a fire set to her apartment building leaves CSI New York team member Stella feeling guilty and homeless.
A shark washes up on shore unloading a dead body and a bizarre crime scene that leaves the CSI New York team more than puzzled.
A high school dance is interrupted by the killing of the school’s guidance counselor. Meanwhile, the taxi cab serial killer is still on the loose.
A professional basketball game ends early after a fan is chosen for the million dollar half court shot where he makes it and inexpediently dies.
The taxi cab killer whom the CSI New York team has been trying to catch strikes again, only this time it’s at the expense of a New Jersey cop.
A bank robbery has Mac doing crime investigation from inside to help the robber prove he didn’t kill one of the hostages.
The bank robbery saga from last season continues as Mac seeks revenge after nearly being killed by the mysterious Joe.
A free street concert quickly turns into a crime scene, the victim, in this case, has been mysteriously plagued with radiation.
Mac is traveling to Washington to testify in court until he realizes he’s in the vicinity of a murder when a stewardess finds a dead body.
A very powerful woman in the world of politics is found dead leaving many desperate in hoping that her information does not get leaked out.
The CSIs investigate the death of a young archaeologist who may have unearthed the answer to one of New York City's oldest murder mysteries.
When three defendants are gunned down on the eve of their trial, Mac is forced to make good on a promise he made to a reluctant witness.

p.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D And Vinny
p.d: The ladies confront their relationship baggage, test out their maternal instincts during a day with Pauly's 'daughter' and pack for a trip on a private jet with the guys.

p.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D And Vinny
p.d: After Pauly takes the ladies to Houston to get a taste of his DJ lifestyle, Vinny takes them to Staten Island to get grilled by his Jersey Shore roommate Nicole.

p.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D And Vinny
p.d: Pauly and Vinny see a different side of the women when the singles' friends and family members visit the house, and Ronnie and Jenni drop by and bring a surprise with them.

p.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D And Vinny
p.d: The truth comes out when Jersey Shore's Jenni and Ronnie subject the singles to a lie detector test, and Pauly and Vinny go on their final one-on-one dates.

p.t: Double Shot at Love with DJ Pauly D And Vinny
p.d: Before the final Cab Ceremony, Pauly and Vinny's moms drop by to meet the remaining ladies, and the guys decide who they want to ask for a shot at love.

p.t: Rock of Love: Hustle on the Bustle
p.d: Twice unlucky in love, this time Bret Michaels leaves his mansion behind and takes twenty even more beautiful babes on tour with him to find a girlfriend who can handle his life on the road.

p.t: Rock of Love: Fifteen Weddings And Three Funerals
p.d: Fifteen girls take turns reciting their own wedding vows to Bret.

p.t: Rock of Love: Babes On Ice
p.d: Bret is looking for a woman with maternal instincts, so he puts his twelve girls in ice skates to see how well they protect Baby Bret against the University of Illinois Women's Hockey Team and special guest player, Lacey.
Bret Michaels has a concert tonight. Ten girls compete to see who can clear the band's equipment off the stage the fastest.

p.t: Rock of Love: Eight Is Not Enough
p.d: The eight remaining girls get a distressing wake-up call when Bret brings in three new girls to join the tour because he's not feeling the emotional effort.
It's Pink Bus vs. Blue Bus in the muddiest of Mudbowls yet! Bret flies away with the MVP for an intimate overnight trip.

p.t: Rock of Love: Truck Stop Games
p.d: In a wacky competition based on beer, babes and truckers, one team will try anything to sway the judges.

p.t: Rock of Love: Bikini Day Care
p.d: The tour hits Panama City Beach, Florida. Seven girls show their mothering skills by taking care of a gaggle of rowdy youngsters at the pool.

p.t: Rock of Love: Exes and Ohs!
p.d: Secrets come out when Bret invites his ex-girlfriend Ambre and Rock of Love alum Heather to interrogate the remaining six girl's exes.

p.t: Rock of Love: Duet To Me One More Time
p.d: Four girls are challenged to write lyrics to one of Bret's songs and sing with him.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: It's a tense time for all and Training Camp Candidates who are not DCC ready will be exposed at the first and only field rehearsal on the Cowboys Stadium turf.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: It has all come down to the final night of training camp. Tonight, dreams will be made or broken.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: In this two-hour season premiere of Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team, 600 hopeful candidates arrive at Cowboys Stadium for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders preliminary auditions.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: Training Camp opens and many of the new candidates have had to uproot their lives and move to Dallas with no guarantee of making it through Training Camp to become a Dallas Cowboy Cheerleader.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: It is just the second week of rehearsals and Kelli and Judy are quick to run the Training Camp Candidates through the signature kick line and jump split.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: In week three of training camp, the rookie candidates are brought in for their DCC makeover. Under the scrutiny of Kelli Finglass, new hairstyles and makeup applications give the girls the DCC look.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: It's week five of training camp and Kelli is out sick. DCC Technical Director, Kitty Carter, fills in and runs the first rehearsal of the week.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: Week 7 of training camp begins with a rehearsal on the field at Cowboys Stadium. Kelli and Judy are ready to make final cuts and tonight's rehearsal could determine who makes the squad.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: It's time to announce the DCC squad but first Kelli and Judy put the candidates through a final field rehearsal at Cowboys Stadium. Tensions run high among the girls as Kelli and Judy watch their every step.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: The squad has their first game day performance behind them, but after a bad rehearsal, Kelli warns her new team she will cut girls if they don't give 110 percent.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders take a break from the sidelines and travel to Mexico for their annual swimsuit calendar photo shoot.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: The Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are in full dance mode preparing for their first regular-season home game performance. Kelli and Judy want the choreography to be perfect and press the girls through a few intense rehearsals.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: In the final episode of the series, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders are preparing for their marquee performance - The Susan G. Komen Cancer Awareness Halftime Show during a nationally televised Cowboys football game.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: Dreams are on the line as the tryouts for the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders 2013-2014 squad begin.

p.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
p.d: The pressure is mounting as 54 new candidates compete with 32 returning veterans for an invitation into the famed Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders training camp.

Eli organizes a surprise birthday party to cheer Clare up, and starts to suspect that she's hiding something. Audra urges Drew to go back to Degrassi. Dave worries that he and Alli are growing apart.

When a group of parents try to stop the play, Eli takes action. As opening night approaches, Tristan realizes that if he doesn't find a boyfriend fast, his first kiss will be onstage -- with Dave. Meanwhile, Becky wants to save Adam.
On opening night for Romeo and Jules, Tristan is nowhere to be found. Is it stage fright -- or something worse? While Eli is busy with the play, Clare decides to get even with Asher.
As Becky begins to fall for Adam, she worries how her conservative parents will react.
Becky doesn't want to keep Adam a secret, so she decides to tell her parents that he's transgender.
Maya is not feeling very good about herself, so she lets Tori give her a pageant-style makeover.
Maya's friendship with Tori is tested when both girls compete in the Miss Millennial pageant.
Frustrated with her heavy workload, Alli decides to have a little fun -- with or without Dave.
After several days without sleep, Alli crashes at the worst possible time.
At the Battle of the Bands, Adam really hits it off with Missy, another musician.
As WhisperHug prepares for the band competition, things get messy between Adam and Missy.
Drew can’t wait to tie the knot with Bianca in Vegas. But the closer they get, the more he second guesses their decision. When Bianca discovers Drew’s wavering, she freaks!

During Spirit Week at Degrassi, everyone has something to prove. Cam feels threatened by Zig, Dallas makes a flirty bet with Alli, and Eli's relationship with Clare is tested.
When tragedy strikes at Degrassi, everyone deals with the situation in a different way. As the students struggle to cope, Simpson cancels Spirit Week.
Alton Brown cooks up some squash recipes and advises on how to choose them.
Alton Brown teaches what to do to return Macaroni and Cheese the table.
Alton Brown discovers the aliens among us are eggplants.
Alton Brown takes the dark antioxidant cocoa and creates delicious treats.
Gelatin's the most mysteriously versatile force in the planetary pantry.
As the holidays approach, Alton Brown ponders the perfect roast beef.
Alton Brown takes on the challenge of making bacon from scratch.
Alton Brown caters a tailgate party and prepares a menu featuring squid.
Alton Brown, the Spud Stud, cooks up potato soup, salad and a Swiss rosti.
Alton Brown deciphers a deceased family baker's famous yellow cake.
Alton Brown demystifies the making of stuffed pasta with an ironing board.
Alton Brown believes a dose of science is all you need to conquer souffle.
Yogurt's not just good for you, it's just plain good.
Alton Brown pushes the limits of his casserole knowledge to free his dog.
Alton Brown creates slaw-tastic salads on a popular morning show.
While a deliriously happy Madison helps new love Brett Hayward move in with her, Steve investigates the brutal slaying of palastic surgeon Dr. Yordsberg.
Roger and Lana's marriage is rocky at best. Lana plots for her lover to kill Roger while he is away for the night on business so that she can have all of his money.

While driving, David tells his wife Laura that he wants a divorce. Laura becomes hysterical and begins to cry and hit him. Trying to fight off his wife's attacks, David loses control of the car and flies into an intersection.
Jim, the hospital janitor, teaches Dr. Sloan some magic tricks. Jim is a whiz at magic and can nimbly manipulate a medallion between his fingers.
George, a schizophrenic homeless man, shows up on a beach prophesizing about death. The couple in the nearby beach apartment, Cynthia and Ethan, threaten to call the police.

When Steve Sloan is hospitalized for injuries sustained in a high-speed car chase, he wakes in a haze and watches with a blurred vision what looks like another patient being stabbed by one of the medical staff in his room.
Nurse Stacy Bradshaw tells Dr. Sloan about her skydiving escapades, and he politely turns down her extreme thrill-seeking invitation to come along.
Dr. Travis catches Dr. Sloan in his office, settling in with a bowl of popcorn to watch a reality television show, Hot House, a Big Brother and Real World type series.
Mark's friends Stanley and Tammy have decided to preview Tammy's new fashion line at their wedding.
At a spiritual retreat, Beth Scarburough confronts Father Dominick about his failed friendship with her husband, Matt. She pleads for him to make amends with his former friend.
Cocky medical student, Hunter Koskov, coerces his classmates, Max and Jenny, to experiment with each other by inducing death.
Amanda does a guest spot as a nurse on the soap opera, where she serves as a medical consultant. Star actress Thalia faints during a scene and is rushed to the emergency room.

Julia Adams comes to Dr. Sloan for a check-up. She seems a little anxious. At the same time, a man comes running through the hospital and in one highly restricted lab, knocks over and breaks a test tube.
Dr. Sloan questions old friend and newspaper baron Barclay about the security company.
Dr. Simon Hodiak, a noted cardiologist, is a gambling addict. When his bookie strong-arms him to repay his debt of $60,000, Simon sells his Porsche.
Exploring fresh archaeological excavations that shed new light on the lives of those who worked tirelessly on the pyramids.

Special effects-filled documentary beginning 49 million years ago. The world is heavily forested and birds rule the planet, preying on small mammals. Whales have not yet evolved, and their ancestors walk on the land.
A pregnant basilosaurus, an 18-metre, carnivorous whale which lives in the Tethys Sea, is forced to kill the young of a smaller whale to ensure the survival of her unborn calf.

Going back 25 million years to the time of the indricothere, which was the largest mammal ever to live on dry land, being seven metres high and weighing 15 tons! The only threat to an adult would have been the Hyaenodon which was the size of a rhino.

The beginnings of mankind can be traced back 3.2 million years to Ethiopia and the advent of Australopithecus, a type of ape which, like humans, was bipedal. These early members of the human family faced many dangers, including the sabre-toothed cat.

Dinosaurs died out 65 million years ago, and we have hardly ever found a complete skeleton. So how do we turn a pile of broken bones into a dinosaur exhibit? Dr Alice Roberts finds out how the experts put skeletons back together.
Professor Challenger leads a party of explorers from the smog of Edwardian London to South America in search of a mythical plateau rumoured to be inhabited by dinosaurs.
Exploring the idea of human coexistence with dinosaurs. Had the species not disappeared from the face of earth ages ago, keeping them as pets could have been a possibility.

David Attenborough tells the story of the discovery and reconstruction in Argentina of the world's largest known dinosaur, a brand-new species of titanosaur. Measuring 37m long, it now holds the record as the biggest animal ever to walk the earth.

Exploring Mongolia's Gobi Desert to determine whether dinosaurs exist in the present as birds. It is one of the harshest places on Earth with the biggest dinosaur graveyard.
