The earth split in India 66 million years ago in a disaster that may have caused the end of the dinosaurs.
Bird expert Bill Oddie helps construct amazing, life-sized, biomechanical replicas as he presents an imaginary battle between a tyrannosaurus rex and a triceratops.
According to new evidence, the Woolly Mammoth went on roaming until about the time the Pyramids were built.

The crew works to restore a 1962 Chevy Corvette to factory condition.

Steve is in northeastern Pennsylvania, tripping through a dormant boneyard.

The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase.
The TARDIS flies into the Mandragora Helix, an alien energy in space.
The Doctor is making enemies of the Court Astrologer Hieronymous.
Torture and death await the Doctor as the Powers of Darkness envelop the Earth.
The Doctor and his companions are trapped in the palace by members of the Cult of Demons.
Sarah finds a mysterious fossilized hand, which re-grows and begins to move.
The hand builds power and reacts to nuclear radiation, causing an overload situation.
The fossilized hand has regenerated into a Kastrian called Eldrad who appears to be female.
Eldrad reconfigures his body to its male form and states he will return to Earth to rule.
The Doctor returns to Gallifrey and races to prevent a tragedy.
The Time Lord president has been assassinated, and the Doctor is the prime suspect.
The Doctor enters the virtual world of the Matrix hoping to track down the Master.
The Master makes his final bid to release the devastating power of the Time Lords.
The Doctor arrives on an alien world and is accused of being 'the evil one'.

After releasing the second part of his autobiography, Dog and his family traveled across America, and this very special episode offers an intimate portrait of both the public and private moments of that journey.

Dog kick-starts the search for Jackson, a 240lbs, six feet tall bad boy who has skipped out on a $10,000 bond. Jackson’s apparently at his father-in-law's house, but the father-in-law has info about Jackson that brings Dog to a unique hideout.

Tim's got a big problem. Owen has failed to appear in court. He's on bond for serious drug charges and now Tim could lose $30,000 if he doesn't catch Owen. With Dog's help he tries to track down the co-signer but they come up dry.
For Dog and Beth, it's not only another day in paradise, it's their anniversary. Beth is hoping for a romantic dinner with her man, but she knows only too well that for Dog work always comes first.
When the co-signer of a bond is also romantically involved with the defendant, sometimes the bondman is put in the middle of a lover's quarrel.

Facing hard time for forging checks, Melissa pulled a vanishing act at her sentencing hearing, bolting from the courthouse in broad daylight. Lucky for her, bondsman Dog and his posse are in Colorado and ready to help.

Dog shows his love of justice and children in this poignant episode. He begins by giving encouragement to a group of handicapped children, then starting the search for Jacob, a fugitive who's abandoned his wife and children.
Dog and the posse travel to the Big Island to help Leland track down a small-time Bonnie and Clyde couple. Their crime: theft, including allegedly stealing a pair of Buddha statues for resale.

Dog, Beth are off to the Big Island for their wedding. They hope to relax for a few days but it turns out Leland has a fugitive he needs to catch and despite the time limit, neither Dog nor Beth can resist the opportunity to catch a fugitive.

With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound? As the family heads out for the seedier side of Honolulu in search of an erotic dancer, we will find out if the wound is truly healed.

New series focusing on the tumultuous home and professional life of bounty hunter Dwayne Dog Chapman, and his partner and wife Beth. In the first episode, Dog and team chase Floyd Chapman (no relation), a heavily tattooed bail jumper.

Dog and his posse head to Colorado for a special mission, to catch Marco, an alleged drug dealer. It's been ten months since Marco went on the lam, and his bondsman stands to lose his family business if Marco is not caught.

It's Halloween, and before Dog and Beth can help the kids carve their pumpkins, they have some business to attend to. It involves knocking on doors and meeting the neighbors, but instead of hunting for treats, they're on the search for a fugitive.

Dog believes in safety first, and today's hunt puts this philosophy to the test. The fugitive's problem with anger management increases the dangers of their already risky line of work. Dog warns the crew to be ready for anything as they head out.

It's the day before Valentine's Day and love is in the air at Da Kine Bail Bonds--but not for Tapi who has failed to appear in court on theft charges. Dog's plan is to have Leland knock on Tapi's door with a Valentine's gift to draw her out.

Happy Birthday, Super Babies! It's the Twins' 1st birthday, and Dora reads them a very special Super Babies story. Once upon a time, there was a cake-snatching bear who stole all the cakes from the birthday boys and girls.
Boots really wants to give his mommy a picture of himself for her birthday, but he's having a really bad hair day! Dora and Boots set out on a Hairy Quest: Boots is ready for his close-up!

Dora and Boots find a lovable little space creature named Winky. He came to visit with his family, our Purple Planet friends. But, uh oh, he's lost. We have to get Baby Winky back to his family before their spaceship takes off!

The Grumpy Old Troll's getting married to Petunia, and we all get to be a part of this wedding! Everything's almost ready, except the Grumpy Old Troll forgot to pick up the rings from his grandma's house! Will we make it in time for the wedding?!
Everyone's dressing up for the big Halloween parade! Dora and Boots are almost set to go, but their friend, Little Monster, doesn't have a costume.
Dora and Boots are going on vacation with Diego and Baby Jaguar at the Rainforest Campground. They're packing everything they need, especially Baby Jaguar's favorite, the Dora Snacks!

The Big Red Chicken's doing magic tricks for us today! For his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken! But when he's going to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that sends the wand flying off into Magic Land, where it breaks!

Dora and Boots are headed to a brand new playground just over the Troll Bridge. When Dora and Boots get to the Bridge, they see that the Grumpy Old Troll's missing! Map tells us that the Troll is stuck in a magic Hole!
Dora's dance class is having a big show for all of their friends and family. Dora's starting the show, and she can't wait for her family to see her dance!
Dora and Boots are heading to the Bike Shop to pick up Boots' very first bike today.
Dora's helping her new friend, Pepe the Pig, learn all about his new school. Pepe's really excited, especially when he hears that if the class earns 3 gold stars today, they get a popcorn party!
Unicornio has been chosen King of Enchanted Forest, but he needs help from Dora, Boots, and YOU to discover that he's kind, smart, brave and strong enough for the job!
Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

Dora and Boots are reading stories about knights when suddenly they hear a cry for help. It's a princess who's calling to us from the Royal Garden! It turns out that it's not the princess that needs saving—her kitty's stuck in a tree!

Swiper was packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his grandma's house. But just as he was about to go, a big wind came in and blew everything away! Will Swiper find a way to use his new super-Swiper-spin today?!

Krystle and Alexis, trapped in a burning cabin far off in the woods, find the door has been locked--from the outside. Mark, who has come to see Krystle in this remote setting, dramatically rescues the two women, who are rushed to the hospital.

Blake and Krystle are to wed.

A serial killer, released from prison, disappears; someone is stalking Antonio.
Jess dreams about people who have disappeared and is teamed with an FBI agent to find a Senator's missing fiancée.
Brooke and Jess investigate the disappearance of an FBI cadet.

Juan Camilo y Nicolás empiezan su viaje escondidos en un camión lleno de café. Se infiltran en los prostíbulos dos agentes y Priscila. Isabel y Julieta les toman foto como prueba de vida para el Capo.
El Capo da 72 horas al Presidente para liberar a su familia. Bruna y Burro trasladan un Santo con el dinero, Esguerra se atraviesa en el camino, ellos logran deshacerse de él. Yupi recibe el dinero.
Bruna y Burro llegan al coliseo con Juan Camilo y Nicolás. Pedro Pablo y Nicolás ultiman detalles de la construcción del submarino. Después del éxito de Priscila tuvo que acostarse con Bermúdez.
Un agente de la DEA acusa a Isabel y Julieta de ser culpables. Llaman a declarar a Laura Montero. Priscila y las prostitutas llegan al billar donde conoce al Avión y al resto de maleantes.
Laura, una de las amantes del Capo, madre de una de sus hijas y del hijo del fallecido Nancho, atestigua en su contra. Tato pone un petardo en la iglesia. Velandia arresta a la madre de Marcela.
Detonan el petardo en la iglesia ocasionando muchos daños. El operativo al billar se ve frustrado. Marcela se encuentra en Argentina. Juan Camilo se entera de la verdadera historia su padre.
El padre Balanta va a contarle la verdad al obispo. Mariale da el primer beso a Esguerra. El presidente brinda su apoyo a Velandia y Priscila. El Capo esta preocupado por las muertes en el billar.
Rubén e Isabel y Julieta cambian de pabellón, no la están pasando bien. Priscila cree que todavía pueden atrapar a Yupi. El presidente y su hijo hablan, emocionado sufre un ataque y es hospitalizado.
Karla advierte a Isabel y Julieta sobre La Negra. Priscila y Velandia asisten a las honras fúnebres. Pedro Pablo se entera de la salud del Presidente. Tato y Bruna mienten sobre los materiales.
Avión asesina brutalmente a Priscila. La familia del padre Balanta llegará muy pronto. Isabel confronta a La Negra. El Capo decide no volver a comunicar al presidente con su hijo.
Rubén les dice a Isabel y Julieta que hay esperanza. Marcela se comunica. Velandia decide secuestrar a Sandra y Patricia. Burro envía un teléfono a Medellín para despistar. Bruna no irá a EEUU.
Hay órdenes de cuidar a Isabel y Julieta. Dos agentes se llevan las pruebas para liberarlas. Burro activa el celular llamando a la casa de Marcela. El Capo bautiza al submarino como Invasión USA.
El alcalde insiste en ayudarle a Tato. Patricia le dice a Velandia saber del escondite del Avión. El submarino será disfrazado como carroza en la procesión. Bruna amenaza de muerte a Pedro y Mariela.
Burro detiene a Bruna de eliminar a su hermana y a Pedro. Velandia asesina al Avión y Yupi. El Moisés y sus insurgentes mueren. La corte falla en contra de Isabel y Julieta, las condenan a 30 años.
Rubén y su hija visitan en la cárcel a Isabel evitan que Julieta suicide. Isabel se entera del amor de Rubén. Bruna se introduce en sumergible. Pedro Pablo dice sus planes a Juan Camilo y a Balanta.

Lucy Ricardo meets her Spanish-speaking mother-in-law for the first time and her efforts to be a gracious host turn disastrous. Lucy's inability to speak Spanish and her in-law's inability to understand Lucy's pantomime erects a wall of misunderstanding.

Lucy is reading The Mockingbird Murder Mystery when Ethel reads her fortune and tells her death is near. Later she overhears a conversation between Ricky and his agent and she jumps to the wrong conclusion that he's trying to do away with her.

Lucy and Ricky are exhausted from walking the baby at night and hire a maid. Lucy prepares a list of dos and don'ts in order to set down the law for her new employee. However when Mrs. Porter arrives, she has her own list for her employer.

The Ricardos have just purchased a new washing machine and despite their better judgment, agree to sell their old one to the Mertzes. The next day the old machine explodes with water and suds and the Mertzes insist that the deal is off.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.
Ethel Mertz interprets a gossip column item to mean that Ricky is interested in one of the chorus girls in his nightclub. Ricky assures Lucy that it's just publicity.

The Ricardos' eleventh wedding anniversary is coming up and Ricky doesn't seem to be picking up the none-too-subtle hints Lucy is giving. She doesn't realize that Ricky has already made plans to buy a string of pearls at a discount from their neighbor.

Ricky insults Lucy's taste in hats so, as a joke, Lucy puts a loving cap trophy on her head that Ricky plans to present to champion jockey Johnny Longden at a National Turf Association dinner later that night. The trophy gets stuck on Lucy's head.
Ricky has planned a surprise party for Lucy's birthday and swears the Mertzes and all their friends to secrecy. Lucy, however, only knows that everyone has forgotten her birthday.
Lucy sees Ricky's screen test as an opportunity to get discovered as a new movie star.

Ricky Ricardo hires business manager Mr. Hickox to solve the family budget problems. Lucy, dissatisfied with her new $5 per month allowance, manages to find a loophole in the business manager's system.

Lucy decides that the Ricardos need a bigger apartment. She discovers that an older couple in the building just had their daughter move out and they no longer need the extra space. All she needs to do is to convince Ricky to go along with the trade.

Although there are perks to living in their new country home, like House And Garden wanting to do a spread on them, the Ricardos find that it is expensive in Connecticut. Lucy decides to raise chickens and sell eggs as a moneymaking sideline.

When Ricky forbids Lucy from gossiping, she tapes her mouth shut but reveals the latest rumor to Ethel through charades. However, it seems it's the proverbial black pot and kettle when Ricky shares with Fred a spicy tidbit about one of his band members.

A close inspection of her marriage license convinces Lucy that she and Ricky are not legally married. Because his name is misspelled on the certificate, Lucy insists Ricky go through the entire courtship and ultimately the marriage ceremony again.

When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

Tori Gets Stuck: Tori is excited when she gets cast as the lead in the school play, but she has to deal with her very unhappy understudy… Jade. Tori has to avoid Jade's constant sabotage so she can perform on opening night.
The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.
Andre spends time with Jade working on a song and develops a crush on her. Tori tries to help him get over his crush, but nothing seems to work, and Andre has trouble keeping his feelings a secret.

p.t: Victorious: Who Did it to Trina?
p.d: Trina stars in Tori's directorial debut, and there is a big accident on opening night. Lane wants to find out what went wrong. Everyone thinks it was an equipment malfunction, maybe it's sabotage.

Beggin' On Your Knees: The Full Moon Jam is coming up. The cutest boy in school wants to perform a duet with Tori, but she finds out he has a reputation. Is Tori just having trust issues, or is this guy bad news?
Tori has to be Trina's assistant for a month. The only way Trina will call off the bet is if Tori wins a private Ke$ha concert. Tori's friends try to save Tori and hopefully score a Ke$ha concert!

Tori rallies the gang into having prom at Hollywood Arts, but the event ruins Jade's art project, and now she's out for revenge. Can Tori throw a successful prom, with Jade aiming to bring the whole dance down?
The kids have to build a float fast. They only have a night to drive the float to the parade. When the float breaks down in a bad neighborhood, can the kids recover and save their chance to be on TV?
The kids have to find the perfect Secret Santa gifts for each other, because whoever gives the worst gift has to go door-to-door yodeling with Sikowitz!
Tori and the gang are forced to spend a Saturday in detention after a lunch trip gone wrong. They have the whole day to learn about each other, find food, and try not to earn more detention.
Team Peck and Team Nunez face off to create custom designs for muscle cars, the artists ink hourglass tattoos on their canvases, and NFL player Von Miller is a guest judge.
One artist cracks under the pressure after an intense Flash Challenge, the artists must cover up lower back tattoos, and tattoo artist Robert Atkinson is a guest judge.
Dave takes a deep dive into the lives and strategies of the final six artists with never-before-seen footage from the season.
The artists carry their own weight in a team Flash Challenge, accuracy is tested in a head-to-head portrait Elimination Tattoo, and artist Tim Hendricks is a guest judge.
The artists must work with their teams to transform canvases into cyborgs, and tattooing legend and author Chris Garver is a guest judge.
The battle comes to a head as the final four artists must endure a grueling 15-hour tattoo marathon.
The final three artists tattoo live for America's vote, the eliminated artists return, and a 24-hour chest piece determines the winner of $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.
Artists from nine of America's best tattoo shops arrive to battle it out for $200,000, the title of Ink Master and the first-ever Master Shop title.
A massive twist shakes up the competition, a painstaking Flash Challenge puts shop relationships to the test, and a tough Elimination Tattoo tests the artists' fundamentals.
A veteran artist returns to take the competition by storm, a difficult Flash Challenge exposes the artists' weaknesses, and the artists tag-team an Elimination Tattoo.
The competition intensifies when the artists are tested on technical application, and two veteran artists make their returns.
Some shops lose their composure during a grueling color realism Elimination Tattoo, and a difficult canvas threatens one shop's spot in the competition.
The competition intensifies as another veteran artist returns, and artists must take on the ultimate test of artistry as they freehand their Elimination Tattoos.
One of the competition's most infamous veterans returns to shake up the game, and the pressure is on when the artists are tasked with a new-school Elimination Tattoo.
An emotional Flash Challenge brings the artists to tears, and the alliance becomes a target when a bulletproof pair of veterans returns to battle it out for the title.
Half demon Inuyasha's secret is that he becomes human once a month. That day, Inuyasha and the gang meet Nazuna and stay at a mountain temple.
The ogress, Urasue, robs the grave of Kikyo, the priestess who sealed away Inuyasha fifty years ago.
Kikyo is revived when Kagome's soul flows into her. She tries to kill Inuyasha, but Kagome takes back her soul.
Miroku, a womanizing delinquent priest, has been collecting Shikon Jewel shards and steals Kagome's shards.
Kotatsu, a painter, sees a dream in which he becomes successful by controlling an army of ogres drawn with ink that has a sacred jewel shard in it.
Naraku appears before Sesshomaru and lends him an arm with a sacred jewel shard embedded in it.
Sesshomaru wields the Tetsusaiga with his borrowed arm against Inuyasha, who fights back with his scabbard.
Kagome has her sacred jewel shards taken away from her and is returned to the present day, unable to return to feudal Japan.
Kagome returns to the shrine in the middle of her date with Hojo. She senses the presence of the Shikon Jewel shards and returns to feudal Japan.
Kikyo, who was brought back to life, is living as a priestess.
Kikyo paralyzes Kagome. Inuyasha appears before her. Kikyo has been gathering the souls of dead girls.
Sango, a demon slayer, is invited to Hitomi Castle along with her father, the leader of the demon slayers, and her younger brother, Kohaku.
Sango fights Inuyasha, believing him to be her enemy. Naraku's plan is to have her fight to the death using the power of the Shikon Jewel shard.
Sango reveals the secret story of the Shikon Jewel's birth.
Inuyasha and the gang meet Taromaru, the son of a village leader. They go to the Temple of the Water God, where children are being sacrificed.
Para el detective astuto y especialista forense, las pistas más importantes a menudo se ocultan a simple vista, y lo que parece trivial para algunos es, en realidad, evidencia crítica.

En las investigaciones criminales, una pista simple puede conectar a un sospechoso con el crimen. La suciedad en los zapatos, los neumáticos, la ropa o una pequeña pieza de plástico pueden ubicar la escena del crimen.
En la mayoría de los homicidios, la policía confía en el móvil para perseguir a un asesino. Pero cuando el asesino es un extraño, el crimen puede quedar sin resolver por muchos años.
En una escena del crimen, cualquier cosa que quedó atrás o está fuera de lugar se considera una pista.

En Filadelfia, una lucha despiadada para hacerse con el poder condujo a una guerra de la mafia a gran escala. La familia del crimen de la mafia local se dividió en dos mientras los jóvenes y los mayores se enfrentaban a muerte.

En 1980, el FBI comenzó una extensa búsqueda de operación encubierta, de nombre en código Safebet, que fue diseñada para exponer la infiltración de la mafia de Chicago en los alrededores de los suburbios de la ciudad.
Chevie y Cheyne Kejoe ganaron la atención nacional después de la grabación de un tiroteo en una cinta con oficiales estatales y locales en Wilmington, Ohio, el 15 de febrero de 1997.

En julio de 1996, dos hombres entraron en una casa de empeño en Birmingham, Alabama, y asesinaron sin piedad a los empleados. Para desconocimiento de los asesinos, una cámara secreta de vigilancia grabó el tiroteo.

Con atención, se monitorea una parada de tráfico que se pone peor. Un tío paranoico buscando objetos perdidos roba a su sobrino. Una mujer en libertad condicional se asusta cuando ve lo que hay en su carro.

Un hombre llama a la policía para que se lleven a su agresivo compañero de cuarto. Agentes tienen que arrestar a un hombre violento en un lugar público. La policía detiene a un sospechoso sobrio, pero con problemas existenciales.
Indigente lucha por su libertad. Un hombre y una mujer sospechosos llaman la atención de un oficial. Una pelea entre pareja llama la atención a una orden judicial pendiente.
La manera respetuosa de un infractor asombra a los agentes. Un oficial sigue sus instintos al ver actividad sospechosa en una gasolinera. Una discusión durante la cena acaba con llamada a la policía.
Un sospechoso de robo vuelve para apoyar a su socio en el delito. Una investigación de autos da lugar a persecución. Un tipo que admite haber consumido drogas dice que lo hace de forma responsable.
Un policía pelea con un drogadicto que se cree Hulk. Los policías atrapan a un conductor que transporta drogas cuando se queda sin gasolina. Un sospechoso se enoja cuando le quitan los calcetines.
Hombre salta de un vehículo en movimiento para evadir a la policía. Una persecución de auto termina con una llamada a los paramédicos. Un hombre confunde hechos peligrosos con heroísmo.
Toby and Oz are taken hostage by two men posing as security guards when they are dispatched to a routine call in the financial district.
When a kidnapped officer escapes her captor, the team discovers a strange connection to her missing husband; Abby knits gifts for the new members of NCIS.

Torres breaks protocol when he learns that a witness in an NCIS case is wanted by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement; Abby, Bishop and McGee try to woo Tony DiNozzo Sr. to sublet Tony's old apartment.
Agent Bishop questions her previous work at the NSA after being sent to Gitmo to gather evidence for a Navy chaplain murder case; Bishop's brothers visit for Thanksgiving.
The team looks into a series of threats against congresswoman Jenna Flemming; Director Vance takes charge of temporary protection detail.
Evidence from the murder of a Navy captain leads the NCIS team to Ducky's deceased mother; the team exchanges holiday gifts; Gibbs has Christmas dinner with Fornell.

Herrmann investigates the rise in missing fire hydrants and teams up with Kylie to track them down; Kidd's cousin comes to town, revealing surprising family history; Violet and Novak treat the victim of a birthday cake smash gone awry.

After a daring rescue at an adventure park, Kidd asks Severide to create a ropes course for Girls on Fire; Violet's former nemesis returns, pleading for her help; Herrmann creates a signature cocktail for Molly's.
A surprise visitor from Novak's past joins Ambo for a late-night ride-along; Herrmann faces a mountain of Chief-level training records and incident reports; Violet catches Carver in a lie.
Kidd and Severide eagerly await big news; Pascal searches for the perfect anniversary gift.
In the face of adversity, Pascal searches for justice; Violet struggles to write a letter to Carver; Damon returns to the floater pool hoping to secure a permanent spot at 51.
Kidd connects with a troubled teen interested in Girls on Fire; Cruz, Capp and Tony eagerly wait to try out Squad's new saw; Violet and Novak are stumped by a bodybuilder who passed out at the gym.
Deputy Commissioner Boden returns to Firehouse 51 to investigate a disastrous firefight and the surrounding mystery that left one of their own in peril.
Severide investigates an old house fire from 10 years back in which Kidd had responded; Carver and Violet search for a mystery medic who abandoned a victim; Novak looks for a roommate.

The clock is on when Ruzek witnesses a woman's kidnapping and the team races to put the pieces together; Burgess tries to connect with Ruzek outside of work, but he mysteriously distances himself from her.
Koshitan tails Nokotan to find her weakness, but discovers her surprising part-time job!
Neko plans to shut Deer Club down, but Nokotan's strange Tsuchinoko leaves her confused!
Koshitan and Nokotan visit Café Tsubame. A deer customer soon pulls Yoshiharu into chaos!
In winter, Deer Club visits a shrine - where Nokotan is suddenly worshipped as a shrine god!
It's sports festival time! Koshitan hopes for peace, but chaos hits the student council!
At the clubhouse, Nokotan's acting strange and tearful - but it's just hay fever!
Hinominami is peaceful - but Nokotan senses Kumatori's hunter aura and tries to avoid capture!
Everyone forgets Nokotan! Can Koshitan handle this serious finale - Farewell Nokotan!?
Beautiful yet aloof Sae irritates womanizer Akihito, who comes across Sae in a vulnerable state.
Sae reluctantly attends a university drinking party, but leaves after he sees Akihito with women.
The two men spend another night in a hotel together. After, Sae finds Akihito talking to a woman.
Jin Kanzaki lives happily with his grandfather, until he comes home to find him covered in blood...
Kouga, dreaming of justice, hunts arson and spots Jin at one of the crime scenes.
As Jin wakes up, Mitsugai watches closely, wondering if this moment will trigger ZET's awakening.
2 years, ZET research struggles; Jin lives alone to protect others. Then suddenly, a woman shows up.

Working in publishing is not what Jane thought it would be, until she learns about a showcase for up and coming writers. With Petra helming the Marbella, she decides to rebrand the hotel, but quickly butts heads with the rival hotel next door.

When Jane is offered a book deal, she thinks her prayers have been answered and debates quitting her publishing job. After suffering from panic attacks, Jane is ready to get to the root of the problem. Rogelio and Xo work on fixing their friendship.

When Jane messes up at Mateo's school, Petra convinces Jane to help with the preschool fundraiser to get in the good graces of the preschool's director. Jane is excited for her first meeting with her editor, but it does not go the way she expected.

Jane feels guilty that she isn't around for Mateo as much as she would like, so she decides to run for Room Mom against none other than perfect mom, Petra. Alba tries to impress her crush, but it doesn't go well.

Jane is finally ready to get back in the dating game so she enlists the help of Rafael and Petra, but it seems they have their own issues to work on. Alba takes Xo and Jane's advice about being an independent woman when it comes to Jorge.

Jane is finally a published author but she's reluctant to talk about her past to help sell her book. Rogelio is intimidated by his new younger male co-star and begins to wonder if the newbie is trying to sabotage him.

Jane is ready for some casual dating and is pleasantly surprised when her date actually helps her fix things with Lina. Petra follows a lead with the help of Chuck that could help her sister's case. Rafael takes Jane's advice.

Jane has to learn how to handle her new love life, especially when the guy she is dating introduces her to his grandmother. Petra learns some interesting information about Chuck. Xo and Rogelio are eager to share their news with Jane.

Jane and Fabian are not on the same page when it comes to their relationship, which makes it hard for Jane to ask him for a favor. Petra and Rafael both turn to Jane for advice, but Jane is determined not to get involved.

Jane struggles to find the right words for Rogelio and Xo's ceremony, when she learns about a mysterious letter that Michael wrote before their wedding. Rogelio and Xo are excited for their big day, but Rogelio gets some shocking news.
When Jane is reunited with her first love, Adam (guest star Tyler Posey), she is shocked but happy to see him, however Xo and Alba are less thrilled that he is back.
Jane's new relationship with Adam helps bring out her fun side and reminds her that she isn't just a mom. However, when Adam gets a job opportunity and doesn't know if he should stay or go.
Jane and Adam's relationship seems to be moving at hyper-speed, and Jane thinks that it might be time for him to meet Mateo, but Rafael is not happy with this idea.
When Jane learns that Rafael introduced Mateo to his new girlfriend, Katherine, without her consent, she gets angry since she thinks Katherine has a negative influence on Rafael and Mateo.
When Adam reveals his dating past to Jane, the information puts a strain on their relationship. Lina seeks Jane's advice about whether she should get married.
Nelson is here to sue his sister who has battled a heroin addiction for two unpaid loans.
Chanel is suing her ex for a birthday gift and emotional distress after finding out he's been texting other women.
McKenzie is suing her baby's father for the price of a car because he chooses work and football over the family.
Eleanor believes that the defendant may be the daughter of her brother, who has been deceased for 18 years.
Delores says her twin sister agreed to split her medical bills when she became ill while planning her party.
Anthony wants David to pay over $1300 in rent and belongings he claims David trashed.
Daniyal is suing her landlord for shutting off her electricity, cutting the gas, and evicting her without notice.
Mirtha is suing her ex-husband for stealing her car and leaving her to pay the bills after he up and left.
Wilda is suing her neighbor for the cost of stolen speakers and $3,000 for harassment.
Miguel is suing his friend of 30 years because he believes the defendant is the cause of his dog's death.
Edgardo is accusing Arron of not paying his share of the rent, and is suing for what he thinks is owed.
Robert is suing his young fling Latasha after claiming she damaged his property.
Donna says the defendants stored their old beat up RV on her property and they owe her money.
Joann says she hired the defendant as a handyman, and he did half the work then disappeared.
After Billie's puppy died 6 days after purchase, she demands the seller reimburse her for vet bills, pain and suffering.
When a family tries to take a nice picture at a wedding ceremony, the Rabbids arrive and mess with the photographer.
The Rabbids discover a discarded cell phone.

p.t: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
p.d: King Koopa helps an infamous criminal; King Windbag's magic wand is stolen.

p.t: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
p.d: The Mushroom Kingdom is sent into the sky.

p.t: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
p.d: Humans are lost in the Mushroom Kingdom; the brothers enter an underwater kingdom.
A damsel in distress from a dragon refuses help from Princess Zelda, but after being saved by Link, the lady rewards her hero with a kiss that turns him into a frog.
A giant magnet pulls the castle underground along with the king and Sprite.
Pac and Fuzbitz go through a space worm to an odd world where everyone is weird doppelgängers from stories.
The diabolical dentures of an evil Mummy wizard could cause the destruction of PacWorld.

When Dr. Buttocks infects Pac-World's computers with his virus ghosts, a digitized Pac must travel through cyberspace and stop the invasion before the evil scientist can download the location of the Repository and the Tree of Life.

p.t: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
p.d: Hoping to acquire Eternia, Webstor unleashes an arachnid catastrophe that hinders He-Man and the heroic warriors' joy of victory over the Snake Men in the Mystic Mountains.

p.t: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
p.d: He-Man and the Masters track King Hiss through Subternia to a long-lost snake temple, which holds the key to releasing a terrible power.

p.t: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
p.d: He-Man tries to stop King Hiss from reaching the Well of Darkness, unaware that Evil-Lyn is planning something catastrophic.
Red and his fearless bird friends must find a way to protect their precious eggs from the Bad Piggies and their relentless assault.
Red and his fearless bird friends must find a way to protect their precious eggs from the Bad Piggies and their relentless assault.

p.t: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape From Paradise
p.d: When Sammy and Ray find themselves trapped in The Tank, an underwater aquarium, they must hatch a plan to escape and reunite with their grandkids, Ricky and Ella, and protect them from the dangers of the ocean.
Travis falls through a magical portal that transports him to the world of American hero Paul Bunyan and his big, blue, talking ox, Babe!

Four teens cast in a plot for a 'Survivor' type TV series end up on a hidden island-like mesa, deep in the jungle, on which dinosaurs and cavemen still live. They must grow up fast and learn to trust one another if they are to make it out alive.

p.t: The Strawberry Shortcake: Sky's the Limit
p.d: When a storm causes a giant boulder to cut off Berry Bitty City's water supply, Strawberry and the girls face the possibility of having to move away from their homes.

p.t: When Zachary Beaver Came to Town
p.d: Welcome to Granger, Texas, and into the life of 12 year-old Toby Wilson. This coming of age story finds Toby in the middle of an unforgettable summer in his normally sleepy Texas town.
When a young mastiff, Bodi (Luke Wilson), discovers a radio, it takes just a few guitar licks for his fate to be sealed: Bodi wants to be a rock ‘n’ roll star!

p.t: Norm of the North 2: Key to the Kingdom
p.d: Norm of the North is back! With the help of his friends, family and some new characters, the king of the Arctic must save New York City and his home.

A wonderful, song-filled feature about an unlovable, murdered mutt (Burt Reynolds) who returns to Earth to do a good deed. He adopts an orphan girl who can communicate with animals and helps lead him to his killer.

Charlie and Itchy are back! Those lovable mutts from the treasured Family hit All Dogs Go To Heaven return for an all-new Animated Musical Adventure. Features the voices of Charlie Sheen, Dom DeLuise and Sheena Easton.
One fish must find his destiny to save his home and the love of his life from a bullying shark.

Trained in the skills of sea power, Pi the fish can fight a shark, sink a squid, or batter any random predator that ever threatens his friends and neighbors on the reef. Unfortunately, being the only hero in town can take its toll.
When a young mastiff, Bodi (Luke Wilson), discovers a radio, it takes just a few guitar licks for his fate to be sealed: Bodi wants to be a rock ‘n’ roll star!

Pitipú recibe una visita de su pasado el cual lleva muchos años tratando de dejar atrás, mientras que el Noruego se embarca en una búsqueda para conseguirle una madre a Olaf.

En una parodia de La Rosa de Guadalupe, el Abuelo es encarado por su familia para tratarse su adicción al sexo, mientras que Peluzín se aprovecha de Olaf para establecer un negocio ilícito en la escuela.
Una hilarante parodia de A Christmas Carol, en la que al Abuelo se le aparecen fantasmas del pasado presente y futuro. Olaf es Timmy y Peluzin el fantasma.
Gaspar cansado de la ineficiencia y corrupción decide postularse como servidor público, mientras que Irma es grabada en una situación incómoda, convirtiéndose en una celebridad.
Pelúzín se roba un paquete de la puerta de Don Sebas, volteando a todo el edificio de cabeza, mientras Jonathan, cansado del bullying del Abuelo decide darle una lección.
LFDB decide hacerle una intervención al Abuelo porque está mas hostil que nunca y quieren que busque tratamiento médico, mientras que Peluzín y Jonathan ayudan a Pitipú a conseguir su nacionalidad.
Despúes de una ardua búsqueda el Noruego encuentra a su padre, mientras que Jonathan ayuda a Peluzín a llevar una vida de bien.
El Noruego decide recuperar a su antigua mascota tlacuache llamada Chofri, mientras que el Abuelo atraviesa por un lapso de demencia senil y depende de Gaspar salvarlo.
Un extraño bebé aparece en la puerta de LFDB, quien viene acarreando una ola de destrucción. Ahora la salvación del mundo depende de la Familia del Barrio.
El Abuelo consigue una ocupación donde se siente como pez en el agua, mientras que Peluzín entra en un proyecto experimental que le traerá muchos problemas a todos.
Gaspar encuentra por fin el amor de manera inesperada mientras que el Pasita, triste por las limitaciones de su edad avanzada consigue la receta para la eterna juventud.
Frustrado por su trabajo, Gaspar busca apoyo en el Abuelo y el Noruego y termina accidentado. Mientras, gracias a la medicina experimental, Peluzín se convierte en el Dr Lambretón.
Pelu el Payaso le pide a Jony que sea su nuevo ayudante e inician una gira espectacular que da muchos frutos. Mientras tanto, el Noruego descubre su afición por los tatuajes.
Peluzín adquiere una nueva mascota que revolucionará el vecindario. En tanto el Noruego y Gaspar intentan ayudar a el Lentejas a superar sus extrañas inclinaciones sexuales.
El Abuelo y el Noruego buscan nuevos horizontes a través de la creación de una fundación, mientras Peluzín cae en la cuenta de su soledad y sale a buscar amigos.
Adem se mueve con rapidez, cerrando un contrato con la empresa de Gözde y asegurando una victoria profesional que toma a Faruk por sorpresa.
Con el amanecer del día de la boda, la alegría se mezcla con el agotamiento. Osman, atrapado entre interminables mandados y familiares bienintencionados, anhela un respiro de calma.
La celebración nupcial se derrumba en medio del caos cuando la respuesta de Burcu en la mesa deja a todos boquiabiertos.
De regreso en la mansión, las consecuencias se profundizan.
Cuando las buenas intenciones de Senem y Akif se vuelven en su contra, una revelación inesperada deja a todos conmocionados.
La familia Boran cae en el caos cuando Fikret es arrestado después de que se encuentran drogas ocultas en la bodega del avión.
Mientras Faruk lidera una investigación exhaustiva, la empresa comienza a perder valor.
Finalmente, la verdad sale a la luz. Con la inesperada cooperación de İpek, Faruk descubre que Adem está detrás de la conspiración que destruyó la reputación de Fikret.
La familia Boran sigue tambaleándose tras el colapso que destruyó su mundo.
La ira de Adem se pudre en el aislamiento. Incapaz de llegar a Dilara ni de recuperar el control de su vida, busca cualquier escape que pueda adormecer su furia.
La esperanza vuelve a encenderse cuando Akif trae una noticia inesperada que sacude a los Boran y los impulsa a actuar.
Mientras la familia se aferra a un optimismo frágil, Esma percibe lo que los demás no pueden: una nueva era ya ha comenzado.
Los Boran dan sus primeros pasos vacilantes hacia su nueva vida en Estambul.
Süreyya encuentra consuelo en su tan esperada reconciliación con Dilara.
İpek, atrapada entre el orgullo y el arrepentimiento, empieza a añorar su glamurosa vida anterior en Nişantaşı. Cada pequeño desaire de su nuevo entorno la hiere profundamente.
An emaciated elderly woman is found dead of an apparent heart attack; her granddaughter is charged with neglect and grave indifference to human life.
Kidnappers abduct the son of Schiff's friend and entomb him in the basement of an abandoned building.
Briscoe and Logan help a young mother who claims her newborn baby was stolen from her after she gave birth in a taxi on the way to the hospital.
Stone faces a tough court battle when a judge is placed on trial and claims the case against him is the vendetta of a former lover.
Briscoe finds it difficult to arrest the son of his former partner when the teen is charged with the murder of a boy in a drive-by shooting.
A physicist is linked to a package delivered through the mail that exploded and killed a rival's wife.
Briscoe and Logan (Jerry Orbach, Chris Noth) investigate five homicides in one chaotic day at the 27th Precinct. Guest stars: Alice Drummond, Victor Colicchio.
The detectives investigate the death of a famous baseball player's father, who gambled his son's earnings on sporting events.
Racial tensions explode into violence after a middle-aged Jewish man leaves the scene of an accident involving a 12-year-old African-American boy.
A 10-year-old disappears after being taken from her alcoholic mother and placed with an abusive couple.
An investigation reveals a strange plot when a professional tennis player's wrist is broken after she finishes a practice session with a former rival.
Stone contemplates resigning when the mob retaliates against his prosecution of a member of a notorious crime family.
A doctor is charged with murder for prescribing a treatment that caused toxic fumes to emit from a breast-cancer patient's body.
Kincaid and McCoy have to decide whether to risk killing a comatose woman to recover the bullet they need as evidence.
A young actress claiming to have been the victim of a white slavery ring becomes the prime suspect when a wealthy Japanese businessman is murdered.

The Ninja and fighters discover there’s a strategic location called The Corridor of Elders where they can make their last stand against Chen’s Anacondrai army... but even with the new Destiny Bounty, their forces still aren’t strong enough.

Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission…
When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu’s staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja

The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn’t keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks.
The Ninja hear of another way to learn Airjitzu - from the ghost of Sensei Yang at his haunted temple - but there’s a warning; if you are trapped in it by sunrise, you will become a ghost, too.

Now that the Ninja know Airjitzu, they get briefed about how the next stage to finding the tomb is to get ‘The Sword of Sanctuary’ from Cloud Kingdom, which can only be reached from the top of the Wailing Alps.
A young park guest accidentally strands himself in the Pteranodon aviary, requiring Owen and a testy Stygimoloch to stage a daring rescue.
Rock star mathematician Ian Malcolm returns to Isla Nublar and helps Claire, Owen, and Hudson deal with strange power surges all over Jurassic World.
The Wolves are still stealing Chi, and everyone else has very little. When a load of CHI falls into the Gorge of Eternal Depth, Laval, Eris and Gorzan must try to retrieve it.

Cragger has been freed and wants to give out CHI to all tribes of Chima, but he has none. He employs a strange Raven alchemist to produce some fake CHI. But the fake CHI has some very unexpected side effects, and the alchemist has an agenda of his own.
Logan's desperation to prove himself leads to his capture by the Nightmare King,which leaves his friends to face the Sheep Week finals alone.
The Dream Chasers rush to save Logan from the Shadowkeep's dungeon,but the liberators soon become the prisoners in a nightmarish twist of fate.
A mysterious dome blocks Mateo and the others from leaving their dream landing, and Zoey and Albert are their only hope of escape.
With Albert captured by the Night Hunter and Z-Blob detained by Agent Strick, it's time for a dual rescue in the Waking World and the Dream World!

Isaiah is mistakenly identified as a member of the Younger Brothers gang when he disrupts a robbery that is taking place.

Charles discovers a morphine addiction is causing Albert's anger.

Mrs Oleson reacts angrily to the news that her 16-year-old son, Willie, is engaged. She tries to prevent the wedding until Willie defies her.
Matthew meets the father who abandoned him; a famous author stays at the Wilder boarding house.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise. Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.

It's the day of the bike parade. But Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd. Barney helps Baby Bop and the children learn all about bicycles—and that they are a wonderful way to exercise and have fun.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it. Along the way, they learn all about cats.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!
The children bring toys to donate to Mr. Boyd's toy drive. Baby Bop and BJ arrive and after some convincing, Baby Bop learns about the merits of sharing.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight! Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice. BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.

Heart forms in the late 1960s with two guys and later includes Ann Wilson and her sister, Nancy.

A critical analysis of the music of Bruce Springsteen.

This is the concert the world never got to see from the biggest live act in the music business. Go onstage with the world's hottest band as they perform the show over one billion people missed when the Internet servers crashed.

No musical group has had as profound an impact on pop music as The Beatles. Tony Palmer’s groundbreaking documentary gives us an intimate look at one of the most influential groups in musical history.

An in-depth look at the elaborate and flamboyant mating rituals of various birds, including the prehistoric-looking cassowary and the male Victoria's riflebird.
During the dry season, the quest for water governs the lives of the animals in South Africa.
The animals are willing to do whatever it takes to protect their food, young ones, and territories. Some of their strategies can put the smartest of human beings in the shade.

Travel to places where migratory whales feed, breed and raise their young despite imminent danger; Swim thousands of miles for a once-in-a-lifetime encounter with a southern right whale that's about to give birth, then meet a curious humpback calf.

Diving into the alien world that emerges whenever the tide goes out; encounter curious creatures that have evolved to endure this zone's extreme conditions, including an air-breathing fish and a predator that turns itself inside out to eat.

Observe the islands' natural rhythms and the challenges of bringing forth new life in this wild outpost; watch as turtles return to their nesting sites, rival iguanas butt heads to win a new mate, and albatrosses conduct sweet courtship dances.
Home to the world's second-largest barrier reef, Roatan is one of the world's top dive spots - known for its rare black corals, low-lying nurse sharks and fearsome-looking barracuda.
Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula houses ships converted to artificial reefs.

Completing the trip's final lap in the untamed lands where Australia's interior desert meets the Indian Ocean; confronting the challenges of survival in the region; Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays and nomadic turtles.
Steve returns home to the Atlantic waters of the British Isles as he considers the question of what humanity can do to ensure the enduring future of whales.

Tag along with Lizzie on her most dangerous Atlantic adventure yet; free diving with bull sharks; explore otherworldly Gulf Coast swamps filled with hungry alligators, crafty snapping turtles and tiny but mighty beach mice who strengthen sand dunes.

Lizzie heads north to tag sharks and witness first-hand the slow disappearance of sea ice; she does time in bear jail with polar bears who are caught raiding a town for food after their hunting grounds diminish.
The marine life living in an expanse of kelp along Africa's southwestern shore.
Chimpanzees that have become captive animals; reintroduction of the colobus monkey to the Ewaso river area.

Matlock’s faith in his ability as a top-notch attorney is completely eroded when he’s dismissed by a client and replaced by a younger lawyer.
During his fishing trip, Matlock encounters the small, unfriendly town of Lone Pine as he attempts to solve the mysterious death of a young farmhand and uncover a town-wide cover-up.
An inmate kills another inmate in self-defense.

A phony story is planted on the nightly news when a corrupt land developer pays off the on-air talent but when the producer fakes his own death, the anchorwoman unwittingly helps him along, never realizing it’s somebody else she killed.
Hired to defend an innocent newscaster, Matlock is baffled until evidence turns up that puts him on the trail of the real killer.
Ben Matlock discovers a hornet’s nest of intrigue, ruthless business tactics and plenty of hanky panky when he defends Dave Travis, the Bad Boy of professional tennis.
Ben Matlock inherits a major problem when he agrees to defend Cliff Lockwood, an anti-social biker with an attitude the size of downtown Detroit.
When multi-millionaire Marvin Estes dies from an apparent suicide, leaving his fortune to supposed girlfriend Theresa LaValle, Matlock must find the missing beneficary.

When it’s discovered that a multimillionaire’s suicide is actually murder, Rick Stafford, the nephew recently cut out of his uncle’s will, is the #1 suspect. However, Matlock suspects other players in this high-stakes game of foul play

When a renowned author is murdered, Matlock defends the accused – the subject of a biography the victim was writing – only to encounter a disturbing revelation about his client midway through the trial.
Matlock is accused of bribing a witness.
When Matlock and his daughter Leanne arrive at a seaside resort to plan their new law partnership, they discover the manager has been murdered.
While vacationing with his daughter, Matlock tries to solve the murder of the hotel manager at their seaside resort.
Matlock takes on the defense of Nguyen Tran, a Vietnamese fisherman accused of murdering the town bully, a man who had been terrorizing Tran and his fellow countrymen.
Matlock reluctantly becomes an angel for a Broadway-bound musical about lawyers when the playwright Sam Spelvin is accused of murdering an acerbic theater critic.

On July 17, 2007, TAM Airlines Flight 3054 slides off runway 35L at Congonhas Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, and crashes at high speed into a warehouse adjacent to a petrol station killing nearly 200 people.
Experts investigate the collision of two planes over the Grand Canyon in 1956, uncovering a frightening problem that threatened the entire aviation system.
When a cargo plane crashes in Alabama, investigators must take an unusual approach to determine what happened on board UPS Flight 1354.
In August 2005, Air France Flight 358 skidded off the runway in Toronto, trapping more than 300 passengers on the plane.
In the extreme conditions of the far North, three flights fall out of the sky.
The tragic circumstances surrounding the bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 by terrorists.
In the worst U.S. crash in more than seven years, a Buffalo-bound flight stalls and plummets into a suburban home in 2009.
After taking off from Taiwan, a China Airlines 747 suddenly disappears from radar and crashes, killing 225 people.
Moments before Pacific Southwest Flight 1771 crashes on a cattle ranch in California, gunshots are heard in the cabin.
The crew of DHL Flight OO-LL must land the plane using only the engines to control the craft when a left wing explodes causing the plane to lose hydraulic pressure.
After a private jet slams into an Ohio apartment building, the National Transportation Safety Board uncovers an erratic descent, a puzzling delay, and a tragic perfect storm.
Internal US flight loses a propeller 19,000 feet over the Pacific Ocean.
A helicopter carrying offshore oil workers crashes into the ocean off the coast of Newfoundland and a far-reaching investigation reveals a fatal flaw.

p.t: Mayday Air Disaster: The Accident Files
p.d: A cargo jet plummets to earth in the Swedish Arctic; as investigators pore over the evidence, a terrifying picture of chaos and confusion emerges.
A Russian pilot allowed his teenage son to take control of Aeroflot Flight 593, setting in motion a chain of events that caused the deaths of 70 people.
An investigation of a car fire and a bludgeoning murder lead Barnaby and Troy to investigate the members of a local reading club which has an agenda that goes beyond books.
Jeff Bowmaker runs a profitable business in Midsomer Magna, conducting spooky ghost tours at night, but the unpopular village librarian turns up dead.
Barnaby and Troy are drawn to Newton Magna where their search for a horse whisperer allegedly struck by a car is complicated by the discovery of a body in the town well.
When an arrogant aristocratic family's decision to develop a memorial garden into a commercial tea shop has the villagers up in arms, murders past and present rear their heads.
The Midsomer Mummers are busy rehearsing when the body of an unknown man is found in their theatre.
The dead body of a local troublemaker and lady's man is found in the model village which is the chief tourist attraction of Little Worthy.
When the director of ‘The Scarlet Pimpernel’ is beheaded by a guillotine on set, Barnaby and Jones must find the killer before the case becomes as bloody as the French Revolution.
The near decapitation of the local postman, whose hyperactive libido also makes him the village lothario, leads to a series of grisly murders involving other promiscuous villagers.
When Midsomer hosts its 12th Annual Literary Festival, an author is found with his neck broken. More writers will die before the winner of the competition is announced.
Barnaby is not impressed when Sarah drags him to a wedding. But things go from bad to worse when he must unveil a murderer with an apparent penchant for local brides.
A heated competition among Midsomer church choirs is interrupted by the bludgeon murder of the Midsomer Worthy's tenor, a local artist.
30 years past their prime, the band Hired Guns hopes to play at the Midsomer Rocks Music Festival. But their fans are disappointed when someone kills the band members one by one.

Steve discovers Ryan may have a potential client for one of the few available units; Ryan's patience is tested by a virtual buyer with a long list of apartment needs and a limited knowledge of the city; KJ lands a prestigious power listing.

Ryan tours a $16 million apartment with some challenging sale details; Steve hustles to sell the remaining four bedroom unit; Fredrik meets up with a developer who drops the bomb that Ryan has been trying to poach his listing.

Steve becomes an unwilling host to a meltdown between Ryan and Fredrik; Tyler hosts a Roaring '20s-themed private showing; At one of Fredrik's private showings, KJ opens up about her future career plans.

Ryan hustles to land his first new development under SERHANT; Fredrik celebrates his decision to go bi-coastal and announces new plans; Steve hits the ice to lock down his 57th Street rental, and Tyler celebrates an emotional closing.

Real estate agents Justin Fichelson, Andrew Greenwell and Roh Habibi strive to outsell one another in a market filled with demanding young tech clients; veteran agent Andrew fails to predict a colleague's mistakes; newcomer Roh must prove his worth.

Justin's new listing in the Mission District is still under construction, so he must sell the neighborhood before he can sell the house; Roh's business partner, Joel, criticizes his open house; Andrew deals with an emotional seller.

Andrew lands a listing in the up-and-coming neighborhood of Bernal Heights; while Justin's property is finally finished, the size of the backyard proves to be a difficult selling point; Roh makes a promise that may be difficult to keep.

Roh finally manages to track down the architect of his new listing, but faces an even harder task; Justin takes a listing with his dentist; Andrew's quest to find a property in Bernal Heights takes an unexpected turn.

In Malibu, condo queen Lydia Simon tries to get top dollar for a beachfront condo before her wedding; Lydia needs to sell the condo and make it to the altar on time; in Hollywood, married agents Dia and Ray deal with a desperate divorcee.

In Hollywood, super agents Dia and Ray contend with a frustrated homeowner who decided to leave the country when George Bush was elected to a second term; in Malibu, smooth-talking agent Scotty Brown tries to get top dollar for a stubborn socialite.
In Hollywood, new agent Chase Campen tries to navigate a big listing, but the buyer is playing hardball; in Malibu, smooth-talking agent Scotty Brown wins a bet and gets a great new listing.

In Malibu, Chris Cortazzo wants top dollar for his hot new beach house; his protégé, Madison Hildebrand, thinks he has the perfect clients; in Hollywood, Michael Wegmann tries to deal with a reluctant seller with a wife who's eager to move on.

In Hollywood, Calif., married super agents Dia and Ray are eager to unload the family home of a lonely daughter who needs to cut ties; in Malibu, Carol Bird tries to sell a horse estate and recording studio for a world-famous violinist.
The team must trick a crooked investment promoter into endorsing $80 million in stolen stocks and then getting them back from him.

Henrik Durvard has taken over the country of Lombuanada by a military coup, and holds the natives in terror. He has obtained a diamond from the native miners, and the IMF is assigned to take it away from him.

Christopher Connelly guest stars as a non-cooperative young computer genius who has dropped out of society, but is desperately needed by the IMF to complete their assignment on Paramount Television's Mission: Impossible.

A dog that collects rare stamps -- on command from the IMF -- figures in a perilous journey to the stronghold of a narcotics kingpin (guest star Fernando Lamas) on Paramount Television's Mission: Impossible.
Guest star Nehemiah Persoff as a corrupt Latin American official plots to loot his own country of $40,000,000 with the connivance of the IMF.
Enemy agent Janos Passik is preparing to train 200 foreign agents to infiltrate the U.S. and engage in some form of bacteriological warfare.

Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.
Sal Mineo guest stars as a ruthless young operator who heads up an international narcotics ring which the IMF attempts to break up on Paramount Television's Mission: Impossible.
Elizabeth Ashley guest stars as a beautiful IMF agent who becomes the key to determining if enemy agent Nicholai Varsi is telling the truth when he claims he's defecting to the United States.
To locate a hoard of stolen money, the IMF takes the one man who knows its hiding place (guest star Stephen McNally) on a bizarre submarine voyage on Paramount Television's Mission: Impossible.

Andrew Duggan guest stars as Justin Bainbridge, a multimillionaire paranoid militarist, whose son, Howard, defected behind the Iron Curtain with the formula to a lethal nerve gas he had developed in A Ghost Story
George Sanders guest stars, one of the world's largest dealers in illegal arms, who is about to complete a deal involving guerilla groups in North Africa and the Middle East in The Merchant
Nora Dawson, a witness to a murder, is committed to an asylum and is being systematically driven out of her mind with drugs when the IMF team is given twenty-four hours to save her life.
The IMF goes to the aid of a friendly South American government which has been overthrown by revolutionaries.
The IMF sets out to destroy a murder-for-hire organization.
Mister Rogers shows a video about how people make peanut butter. Lady Aberlin agrees to take care of Daphne. Henrietta Pussycat suggests making a daycare center at the factory, and Corney agrees.

Mister Rogers meets Natasha, a famous oboeist. She shows pictures of her children and says she expresses her feelings for them through her music. Prince Tuesday is considering getting sick so that his parents will stay home from work.

Marilyn Barnett invites Mister Rogers outside for some exercises. Bruce Franco carries a collection of balloon scuptures he has made for the party. He gives Mister Rogers a balloon sculpture that looks like the Neighborhood Trolley.

Mister Rogers introduces a week of programs about the environment. He shows how things can be reused. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, there's a real-life problem -- too much garbage -- and the neighbors are trying to find a solution.

Mister Rogers arrives with a bandage on his left hand. He pulls back the bandage to show that his hand is still there. Ana scraped her paw but does not want a bandage. Lady Aberlin is able to convince her otherwise.

Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make adhesive bandages. Prince Tuesday is looking for someone to play with but all of his friends are busy. At the suggestion of King Friday, he pretends that his rag doll has come to life.

Mister Rogers shows a video of wolves singing, and wolf expert Kent Weber stops by with two wolves and explains that wolves are shy, not big and bad like in the fairy tales, and how they live together in families.
Folksinger Ella Jenkins visits Mister Rogers with her ukulele and shares songs her father enjoyed.
Yo-Yo Ma describes how he misses his family when he is gone and plays Bach's Sarabande on his cello. Sitting at the piano, Yo-Yo's son Nicholas plays the Skater's Waltz as a duet with his father.

Mister Rogers goes to Brockett's Bakery to decorate gingerbread men. After hearing the sound effect from the laughing box, Lady Aberlin sees how long neighbors take to laugh. Eric Kloss makes different sounds using a wind synthesizer.
Mister Rogers plays with different-sized cardboard tubes. Lady Aberlin is observing how neighbors react to the laughter box. Dr. Maggie Kimmel tells the story of “Button Broth.”

Mister Rogers shows a video of how people make toothbrushes. Lady Aberlin observes the neighbors' reactions after she can turn herself into a tiger. Princess Zelda arrives in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

p.d: La Venganza de los EX reune a 10 solteros y solteras que se van de vacaciones al paraiso, pero todo se distorsiona cuando suena la tablet del terror y les anuncia la llegada de sus EX.
Alejandra tiene una relación en línea hace tres años con Andrés David. Ambos viven en la misma ciudad pero hasta el día de hoy no se han conocido en persona ni por videollamadas.

Samuel lleva ya siete meses hablando en línea con Marina. En un comienzo ambos descubrieron que compartían muchos gustos en común, pero Samuel encontraba sospechosas todas las excusas que daba Marina a la hora de conocerse.

p.t: La venganza de los ex: Caribe
p.d: La Venganza de los Ex: Caribe comienza con una fiesta en un barco en el Caribe. Hadad es el primer ex en llegar. Ortega se divide entre Camila y Mariana. Entre discusión y discusión, los participantes acaban buscando a un nuevo ex.

p.t: La venganza de los ex: Caribe
p.d: Ortega, JV y Mario reciben a Mari A en la playa. De vuelta a casa, JV intenta ligar con Leticia. Ortega acude a una cita con Mari F. En la primera suite principal, la recién llegada Mari A, elige a JV. Leticia, Haexa y Vaski salen a buscar a otro ex.

p.t: La venganza de los ex: Caribe
p.d: Let, Haexa y Vaski reciben a Apolo, el ex de Leticia. Vaski es quien toma el pelo a la novata. Ortega se debate entre Camila y Mariana y JV no puede decidirse entre Mari A y Leticia, lo que culmina en una gran bronca tras la Pool Party.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
p.d: La tensión parece calmarse tras la reconciliación entre Diana y Brandon. Camilo y David tienen una plática sincera y Kelly aclara sus intenciones con Karen. Daphne saca su furia y arremte contra Aylin.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
p.d: Dos nuevos EX llegan a la Villa y se desatan los celos. Diana deja las cosas claras con Brandon en la Love Suite. Todos disfrutan de un día fuera de la Villa y el alcohol les ayuda a encararse.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
p.d: Esteban busca hacer un trío y Aylin busca exclusividad. Llega un nuevo EX y hace que Frida respire de nuevo. Diana esta insegura de Brandon. Kelly es mas territorial con Robbie por culpa de Michelle.

p.t: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
p.d: En medio de una fiesta, Camilo se casa con David en el peor momento y se abre la Sala Tornado desatando nuevos conflictos. Kim va por Ian, mientras que Suavecito llama a no engancharse con sus parejas.
Todo lo que empieza tiene que terminar y así pasa con estas vacaciones en las costas del mediterráneo. Llega la hora en que los chicos de Súper Shore deberán de despedirse.

Los Shores reunidos repasan los mejores momentos de sus segundas vacaciones en un especial confidencial. Ellos verán las mejores fiestas, las peleas, los momentos más importantes de sus vacaciones y lo que eso conlleva

Luffy emerges safely! And Pekoms' bravery ensures he and the Straw Hats have a fighting chance! But can they withstand the full force of the Big Mom Pirates? At the last moment - a surprise explodes onto the scene!

Sanji tries his best to save himself and his captain, Luffy! But the arrival of Germa has complicated matters. Whose side do these powerful superhumans fight on? In the end, sisterly love will see Sanji saved!

Luffy and Sanji are safe! But the critical moment approaches - the fate of Totto Land rests on the taste of the wedding cake! Will it be sweet release or bitter defeat? Meanwhile, a cunning pincer attack leaves the Straw Hats hopelessly trapped.

With the help of the Sun Pirates, the Straw Hats see their chance to escape! And the Sun Pirates bid farewell to their former captain. Mama finally tastes the Wedding Cake and the results are positively scrumptious!

The Big Mom Pirates fooled! The Straw Hats have eluded their would-be tormentors with the help of the Sun Pirates! However, as the fleet of the Big Mom Pirates is still coming after them, Jimbei makes a crucial decision to help the Sunny to get away.

At a great cost of energy and life, the Straw Hats make it out of Totto Land. Left behind in their wake are allies and friends, and would-be lovers. As the sea opens before them, what price has been paid for their escape?

Luffy's recent exploits make their way around the world! The reputation of this mighty pirate begins to grow as all eyes look towards the Straw Hats' next move! Also - German 66 leaves an artifact behind which excites the crew!

As the royals make their way to the Reverie, the mighty Navy takes all precautions to make sure they don't fall prey to kidnappings! At the vanguard is Koby, who glimpses Luffy's exploits and remembers their shared past.

A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard's affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help.

At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!

Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague.
Stelly, Sabo's adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve.

Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.

Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.

Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon.

Tarawa was the most strongly defended island in the Pacific which the Japanese boasted that a million Americans couldn’t take the island in one hundred years. On Tarawa the Marines faced their sternest test yet.

Galaxia is revealed to be the Legendary Sailor Guardian who sealed away Chaos. She has become corrupt and has gone on to conquer the galaxy herself.
As Galaxia closes in to take Sailor Moon’s star seed, the Light of Hope reveals itself. The Light of Hope begs Usagi to use its power to stop Galaxia.
Usagi Tsukino is clumsy at times and a bit of a crybaby. Luna, a black cat with a crescent moon on her forehead, gives Usagi a miracle brooch.
Usagi becomes close with Ami Mizuno, a genius with an IQ of 300. But there's something odd about the students at Ami's seminar.
Disturbing rumors about a certain bus swirl all around Usagi. Amid the rumors, Usagi meets a beautiful shrine maiden with black hair named Rei Hino.
Usagi learns of a secret treasure exhibit and, suspecting it might be the 'Legendary Silver Crystal,' sneaks into the embassy of Kingdom D.
All of Juban Middle School is talking about the 'cursed bridal shop,' where every man who visits is said to disappear.
Tuxedo Mask is reported to have committed many crimes to obtain the 'Legendary Silver Crystal,' but Usagi doesn't believe it…
Usagi learns Tuxedo Mask's identity is actually Mamoru Chiba. Meanwhile, brainwashed people in Usagi's town wander around looking for Sailor Moon.
Una paciente no puede recordar los últimos 20 años de su vida, pero para tratarla sus médicos necesita saber desesperadamente lo que ha olvidado.

Dos víctimas de accidentes automovilísticos, un hombre y una mujer, llegan por separado y casi desnudos, pero gradualmente se revela su historia de pasión e infidelidad; Se descubre que un niño que sufre de náuseas tiene un bloqueo cardíaco.
Dos mujeres bien vestidas están listas para ir a la ciudad, pero terminan en la sala de emergencias.
Una mujer joven es llevada de urgencia a la sala de emergencias luego de ser mordida en la cara por un perro.
Cuatro patinadores Triage. Transfusión ordenada por la corte. El doctor trata al buscador de drogas.

Un devastador tornado F-5 ha barrido el sur de Oklahoma, y el hospital es el principal centro de trauma para las víctimas heridas. Cuando un paciente gravemente herido es llevado urgentemente a la sala de emergencias.
Una ciclista de montaña tiene múltiples heridas y su novio tiene múltiples desmayos.
Una mujer embarazada no puede llegar al hospital a tiempo y debe dar a luz en el asiento delantero de su automóvil.
Un hombre es atravesado en el abdomen por un tacón de aguja; un amante de la naturaleza aparentemente saludable tiene una serie de convulsiones que desconciertan a sus médicos.
El corazón de una víctima de apuñalamiento tiene un agujero en él y debe ser bombeado a mano para mantenerlo vivo.

Una adolescente está sangrando internamente por un embarazo ectópico, pero niega haber tenido relaciones sexuales, por lo que su médico debe encontrar una manera inteligente de probar su embarazo antes de poder tratarla.
Un paciente es mordido por una serpiente. El pecho de un paciente con VIH explota y un hombre de 600 libras debe entrar en la sala de emergencias.
Los doctores están desconcertados cuando traen a un almirante retirado y no entienden lo que lo debilita cada día más.

Darlene has issues with Dan's plumbing work in her new house; Jackie tries to find a caregiver for Bev.
Darlene continues her search for a new job; Becky is desperate to spend more time with Beverly Rose.
Doug and Carrie’s new freshly-starched neighbors appear to have only one flaw – a noisy nocturnal dog named Stanley.

Doug doesn’t really want to meet Carrie at an important client party does everything in his power to shave time – including skipping lunch, snacks and dinner - off his double shift to surprise Carrie at the event.
Carrie has just been issued her fourth traffic ticket this year. And her status as a persistent violator will double the Heffernan’s insurance rates.
Doug and Carrie have big plans for Valentine’s Day – a romantic dinner and the house to themselves - but Cupid’s arrow has a few diversions planned.
When Doug and Deacon’s IPS shift supervisor takes ill, Doug is temporarily promoted to the position.
When Ray Romano calls and asks Doug if he wants to play golf at his private club, Doug cancels on his friend Richie-who he was going to spend the day with in order to comfort him after his divorce.
Doug gets a new trainee at work, and much to his surprise, she’s blond and beautiful.
Doug and Carrie pine for the privacy they used to have before Arthur moved in.

When Dave's job requires him to mediate a feud between two wealthy brothers, Calvin tries to help but winds up complicating the process; Gemma turns to Tina for assistance in navigating Grover's first crush.

Calvin and Tina offer to throw a quinceañera for Yoli (Alycia Pascual-Pena), a teen Calvin is mentoring at his auto shop. Also, Dave and Gemma introduce Malcolm to a college baseball coach who has the potential to change his future.
When Calvin is honored by the Chamber of Commerce for the positive impact his business has had on the community, he hopes to finally gain the approval of his mother, Marilyn.
When Tina reunites with her former girl group after decades apart, old issues are reignited, threatening to derail the trio's big performance.
A spelling bee forces Foxxy to confront her champion past. Clara becomes addicted to car crashes.
